   112→        plan["queue_order"] = []

   127→    if not isinstance(plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta"), dict):

   131→def _migrate_deferred_to_skipped(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   132→    deferred: list[str] = plan["deferred"]
   133→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   134→    if not deferred:
   135→        return
   136→
   137→    now = utc_now()
   138→    for fid in list(deferred):
   139→        if fid in skipped:
   140→            continue
   141→        skipped[fid] = {
   142→            "finding_id": fid,
   143→            "kind": "temporary",
   144→            "reason": None,
   145→            "note": None,
   146→            "attestation": None,
   147→            "created_at": now,
   148→            "review_after": None,
   149→            "skipped_at_scan": 0,
   150→        }
   151→    deferred.clear()
   152→
   153→
   154→def _normalize_cluster_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   155→    for cluster in plan["clusters"].values():
   156→        if not isinstance(cluster, dict):
   157→            continue
   158→        if not isinstance(cluster.get("finding_ids"), list):
   159→            cluster["finding_ids"] = []
   160→        cluster.setdefault("auto", False)
   161→        cluster.setdefault("cluster_key", "")
   162→        cluster.setdefault("action", None)
   163→        cluster.setdefault("user_modified", False)
   164→
   165→
   166→def _migrate_epics_to_clusters(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   167→    """Migrate v3 top-level ``epics`` dict into ``clusters`` (v4 unification)."""
   168→    epics = plan.pop("epics", None)
   169→    if not isinstance(epics, dict) or not epics:
   170→        return
   171→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   172→    now = utc_now()
   173→    for name, epic in epics.items():
   174→        if not isinstance(epic, dict):
   175→            continue
   176→        if name in clusters:
   177→            continue  # don't overwrite existing cluster
   178→        clusters[name] = {
   179→            "name": name,
   180→            "description": epic.get("thesis", ""),
   181→            "finding_ids": epic.get("finding_ids", []),
   182→            "auto": True,
   183→            "cluster_key": f"epic::{name}",
   184→            "action": f"desloppify plan focus {name}",
   185→            "user_modified": False,
   186→            "created_at": epic.get("created_at", now),
   187→            "updated_at": epic.get("updated_at", now),
   188→            # Epic-specific fields
   189→            "thesis": epic.get("thesis", ""),
   190→            "direction": epic.get("direction", "simplify"),
   191→            "root_cause": epic.get("root_cause", ""),
   192→            "supersedes": epic.get("supersedes", []),
   193→            "dismissed": epic.get("dismissed", []),
   194→            "agent_safe": epic.get("agent_safe", False),
   195→            "dependency_order": epic.get("dependency_order", 999),
   196→            "action_steps": epic.get("action_steps", []),
   197→            "source_clusters": epic.get("source_clusters", []),
   198→            "status": epic.get("status", "pending"),
   199→            "synthesis_version": epic.get("synthesis_version", 0),
   200→        }
   201→
   202→
   203→def ensure_plan_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   204→    """Normalize a loaded plan to ensure all keys exist.
   205→
   206→    Handles migration from v1 (deferred list) to v2 (skipped dict),
   207→    and v3 (top-level epics) to v4 (epics unified into clusters).
   208→    """
   209→    defaults = empty_plan()
   210→    for key, value in defaults.items():
   211→        plan.setdefault(key, value)
   212→
   213→    _ensure_container_types(plan)
   214→    _migrate_deferred_to_skipped(plan)
   215→    _migrate_epics_to_clusters(plan)
   216→    _normalize_cluster_defaults(plan)
   217→
   218→
   219→def synthesis_clusters(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Cluster]:
   220→    """Return clusters whose name starts with ``EPIC_PREFIX``."""
   221→    return {
   222→        name: cluster
   223→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   224→        if name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX)
   225→    }
   226→
   227→
   228→def validate_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   229→    """Raise ValueError when plan invariants are violated."""
   230→    if not isinstance(plan.get("version"), int):
   231→        raise ValueError("plan.version must be an int")
   232→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   233→        raise ValueError("plan.queue_order must be a list")
   234→
   235→    # No ID should appear in both queue_order and skipped
   236→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   237→    overlap = set(plan["queue_order"]) & skipped_ids
   238→    if overlap:
   239→        raise ValueError(
   240→            f"IDs cannot appear in both queue_order and skipped: {sorted(overlap)}"
   241→        )
   242→
   243→    # Validate skip entry kinds
   244→    for fid, entry in plan.get("skipped", {}).items():
   245→        kind = entry.get("kind")
   246→        if kind not in VALID_SKIP_KINDS:
   247→            raise ValueError(
   248→                f"Invalid skip kind {kind!r} for {fid}; must be one of {sorted(VALID_SKIP_KINDS)}"
   249→            )
   250→

1→"""Post-scan plan reconciliation — handle finding churn."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     6→from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
     7→
     8→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import EPIC_PREFIX, PlanModel, SupersededEntry, ensure_plan_defaults
     9→from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX, SYNTHESIS_ID
    10→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel, utc_now
    11→
    12→
    13→SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS = 90
    14→
    15→
    16→@dataclass
    17→class ReconcileResult:
    18→    """Summary of changes made during reconciliation."""
    19→
    20→    superseded: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    21→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    22→    resurfaced: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    23→    changes: int = 0
    24→
    25→
    26→def _find_candidates(
    27→    state: StateModel, detector: str, file: str
    28→) -> list[str]:
    29→    """Find open findings that could be remaps for a disappeared finding."""
    30→    candidates: list[str] = []
    31→    for fid, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items():
    32→        if finding.get("status") != "open":
    33→            continue
    34→        if finding.get("detector") == detector and finding.get("file") == file:
    35→            candidates.append(fid)
    36→    return candidates
    37→
    38→
    39→def _is_finding_alive(state: StateModel, finding_id: str) -> bool:
    40→    """Return True if the finding exists and is open."""
    41→    finding = state.get("findings", {}).get(finding_id)
    42→    if finding is None:
    43→        return False
    44→    return finding.get("status") == "open"
    45→
    46→
    47→def _supersede_id(
    48→    plan: PlanModel,
    49→    state: StateModel,
    50→    finding_id: str,
    51→    now: str,
    52→) -> bool:
    53→    """Move a disappeared finding to superseded. Returns True if changed."""
    54→    finding = state.get("findings", {}).get(finding_id)
    55→    detector = ""
    56→    file = ""
    57→    summary = ""
    58→    if finding:
    59→        detector = finding.get("detector", "")
    60→        file = finding.get("file", "")
    61→        summary = finding.get("summary", "")
    62→
    63→    candidates = _find_candidates(state, detector, file) if detector else []
    64→    # Don't include the original in candidates
    65→    candidates = [c for c in candidates if c != finding_id]
    66→
    67→    entry: SupersededEntry = {
    68→        "original_id": finding_id,
    69→        "original_detector": detector,
    70→        "original_file": file,
    71→        "original_summary": summary,
    72→        "status": "superseded",
    73→        "superseded_at": now,
    74→        "remapped_to": None,
    75→        "candidates": candidates[:5],
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    # Preserve any existing override note
    79→    override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(finding_id)
    80→    if override and override.get("note"):
    81→        entry["note"] = override["note"]
    82→
    83→    plan["superseded"][finding_id] = entry
    84→
    85→    # Remove from queue_order, skipped, cluster finding_ids
    86→    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    87→    skipped: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    88→    if finding_id in order:
    89→        order.remove(finding_id)
    90→    skipped.pop(finding_id, None)
    91→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
    92→        ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
    93→        if finding_id in ids:
    94→            ids.remove(finding_id)
    95→
    96→    # Clear stale cluster reference from override
    97→    override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(finding_id)
    98→    if override and override.get("cluster"):
    99→        override["cluster"] = None
   100→        override["updated_at"] = now
   101→
   102→    return True
   103→
   104→
   105→def _prune_old_superseded(plan: PlanModel, now_dt: datetime) -> list[str]:
   106→    """Remove superseded entries older than TTL. Returns pruned IDs."""
   107→    superseded = plan.get("superseded", {})
   108→    cutoff = now_dt - timedelta(days=SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS)
   109→    to_prune: list[str] = []
   110→
   111→    for fid, entry in superseded.items():
   112→        ts = entry.get("superseded_at", "")
   113→        try:
   114→            entry_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
   115→            if entry_dt.tzinfo is None:
   116→                entry_dt = entry_dt.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
   117→            if entry_dt < cutoff:
   118→                to_prune.append(fid)
   119→        except (ValueError, TypeError):
   120→            to_prune.append(fid)
   121→
   122→    for fid in to_prune:
   123→        superseded.pop(fid, None)
   124→        # Also clean up stale overrides
   125→        plan.get("overrides", {}).pop(fid, None)
   126→
   127→    return to_prune
   128→
   129→
   130→def reconcile_plan_after_scan(
   131→    plan: PlanModel,
   132→    state: StateModel,
   133→) -> ReconcileResult:
   134→    """Reconcile plan against current state after a scan.
   135→
   136→    Finds IDs referenced in the plan that no longer exist or are no longer
   137→    open, moves them to superseded, and prunes old superseded entries.
   138→    """
   139→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   140→    result = ReconcileResult()
   141→    now = utc_now()
   142→    now_dt = datetime.now(UTC)
   143→
   144→    # Collect all finding IDs referenced by the plan
   145→    referenced_ids: set[str] = set()
   146→    referenced_ids.update(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   147→    referenced_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   148→    for override_id in plan.get("overrides", {}):
   149→        referenced_ids.add(override_id)
   150→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   151→        referenced_ids.update(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   152→
   153→    # Exclude already-superseded IDs and synthetic IDs (managed by stale_dimensions)
   154→    already_superseded = set(plan.get("superseded", {}).keys())
   155→    referenced_ids -= already_superseded
   156→    referenced_ids = {
   157→        fid for fid in referenced_ids
   158→        if not fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   159→        and fid != SYNTHESIS_ID
   160→    }
   161→
   162→    # Check each referenced ID
   163→    for fid in sorted(referenced_ids):
   164→        if not _is_finding_alive(state, fid):
   165→            if _supersede_id(plan, state, fid, now):
   166→                result.superseded.append(fid)
   167→                result.changes += 1
   168→
   169→    # Reconcile epic clusters: remove dead findings, delete empty epics
   170→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   171→    epic_names_to_delete: list[str] = []
   172→    for name, cluster in list(clusters.items()):
   173→        if not name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX):
   174→            continue
   175→        finding_ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   176→        alive_ids = [fid for fid in finding_ids if _is_finding_alive(state, fid)]
   177→        if alive_ids != finding_ids:
   178→            cluster["finding_ids"] = alive_ids
   179→            result.changes += 1
   180→        if not alive_ids:
   181→            epic_names_to_delete.append(name)
   182→    for name in epic_names_to_delete:
   183→        clusters.pop(name, None)
   184→        result.changes += 1
   185→
   186→    # Resurface stale temporary skips
   187→    scan_count = state.get("scan_count", 0)
   188→    from desloppify.engine._plan.operations import resurface_stale_skips
   189→
   190→    resurfaced = resurface_stale_skips(plan, scan_count)
   191→    if resurfaced:
   192→        result.resurfaced = resurfaced
   193→        result.changes += len(resurfaced)
   194→
   195→    # Prune old superseded entries
   196→    pruned = _prune_old_superseded(plan, now_dt)
   197→    result.pruned = pruned
   198→    result.changes += len(pruned)
   199→
   200→    # Log reconciliation if any changes were made
   201→    if result.changes > 0:
   202→        from desloppify.engine._plan.operations import append_log_entry
   203→
   204→        append_log_entry(
   205→            plan,
   206→            "reconcile",
   207→            finding_ids=result.superseded,
   208→            actor="system",
   209→            detail={
   210→                "superseded_count": len(result.superseded),
   211→                "pruned_count": len(result.pruned),
   212→                "resurfaced_count": len(result.resurfaced),
   213→            },
   214→        )
   215→
   216→    return result
   217→
   218→
   219→__all__ = [
   220→    "ReconcileResult",
   221→    "reconcile_plan_after_scan",
   222→]
   223→

1→"""Sync subjective dimensions into the plan queue.
     2→
     3→Two independent sync functions:
     4→
     5→- **sync_unscored_dimensions** — prepend never-scored (placeholder) dimensions
     6→  to the *front* of the queue unconditionally (onboarding priority).
     7→- **sync_stale_dimensions** — append stale (previously-scored) dimensions to
     8→  the *back* of the queue when no objective items remain.
     9→"""
    10→
    11→from __future__ import annotations
    12→
    13→import hashlib
    14→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    15→
    16→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel, ensure_plan_defaults
    17→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    18→
    19→SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX = "subjective::"
    20→SYNTHESIS_ID = "synthesis::pending"
    21→
    22→
    23→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    24→# Result dataclasses
    25→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    26→
    27→@dataclass
    28→class StaleDimensionSyncResult:
    29→    """What changed during a stale-dimension sync."""
    30→
    31→    injected: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    32→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    33→
    34→    @property
    35→    def changes(self) -> int:
    36→        return len(self.injected) + len(self.pruned)
    37→
    38→
    39→@dataclass
    40→class UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
    41→    """What changed during an unscored-dimension sync."""
    42→
    43→    injected: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    44→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    45→
    46→    @property
    47→    def changes(self) -> int:
    48→        return len(self.injected) + len(self.pruned)
    49→
    50→
    51→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    52→# ID helpers
    53→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    54→
    55→def _current_stale_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    56→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently stale."""
    57→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    58→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    59→        scorecard_subjective_entries,
    60→    )
    61→
    62→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
    63→    if not dim_scores:
    64→        return set()
    65→
    66→    stale: set[str] = set()
    67→    for entry in scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
    68→        if not entry.get("stale"):
    69→            continue
    70→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
    71→        if dim_key:
    72→            stale.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    73→    return stale
    74→
    75→
    76→def _current_unscored_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    77→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently unscored (placeholder).
    78→
    79→    Checks ``subjective_assessments`` directly because
    80→    ``scorecard_subjective_entries`` filters out placeholder dimensions
    81→    (they are hidden from the scorecard display).
    82→    """
    83→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    84→
    85→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    86→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    87→        return set()
    88→
    89→    unscored: set[str] = set()
    90→    for dim_key, payload in assessments.items():
    91→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    92→            continue
    93→        if not payload.get("placeholder"):
    94→            continue
    95→        if dim_key:
    96→            unscored.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    97→    return unscored
    98→
    99→
   100→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   101→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   102→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   103→
   104→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   105→    plan: PlanModel,
   106→    state: StateModel,
   107→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   108→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   109→
   110→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   111→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   112→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   113→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   114→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   115→    """
   116→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   117→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   118→    unscored_ids = _current_unscored_ids(state)
   119→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   120→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   121→
   122→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   123→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   124→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   125→        fid for fid in order
   126→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   127→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   128→        and fid not in stale_ids
   129→    ]
   130→    for fid in to_remove:
   131→        order.remove(fid)
   132→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   133→
   134→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs to front ----------------------------
   135→    existing = set(order)
   136→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   137→        if uid not in existing:
   138→            order.insert(0, uid)
   139→            result.injected.append(uid)
   140→
   141→    return result
   142→
   143→
   144→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   145→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   146→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   147→
   148→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   149→    plan: PlanModel,
   150→    state: StateModel,
   151→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   152→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale subjective dimensions.
   153→
   154→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   155→       longer stale and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned by
   156→       ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   157→    2. If no objective items remain after cleanup, inject all currently-stale
   158→       dimension IDs so the plan surfaces them as actionable work.
   159→    """
   160→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   161→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   162→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   163→    unscored_ids = _current_unscored_ids(state)
   164→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   165→
   166→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   167→    # Only prune IDs that are neither stale nor unscored.
   168→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   169→        fid for fid in order
   170→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   171→        and fid not in stale_ids
   172→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   173→    ]
   174→    for fid in to_remove:
   175→        order.remove(fid)
   176→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   177→
   178→    # --- Inject: populate when no objective items remain -----------------
   179→    has_real_items = any(fid for fid in order if not fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX))
   180→    if not has_real_items and stale_ids:
   181→        existing = set(order)
   182→        for sid in sorted(stale_ids):
   183→            if sid not in existing:
   184→                order.append(sid)
   185→                result.injected.append(sid)
   186→
   187→    return result
   188→
   189→
   190→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   191→# Synthesis snapshot hash + sync
   192→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   193→
   194→def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   195→    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
   196→
   197→    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
   198→    """
   199→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   200→    review_ids = sorted(
   201→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   202→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   203→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   204→    )
   205→    if not review_ids:
   206→        return ""
   207→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   208→
   209→
   210→@dataclass
   211→class SynthesisSyncResult:
   212→    """What changed during a synthesis sync."""
   213→
   214→    injected: bool = False
   215→    pruned: bool = False
   216→
   217→    @property
   218→    def changes(self) -> int:
   219→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   220→
   221→
   222→def sync_synthesis_needed(
   223→    plan: PlanModel,
   224→    state: StateModel,
   225→) -> SynthesisSyncResult:
   226→    """Inject ``synthesis::pending`` at front of queue when review findings change.
   227→
   228→    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion (``_apply_completion``) removes it.
   229→    """
   230→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   231→    result = SynthesisSyncResult()
   232→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   233→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   234→    already_present = SYNTHESIS_ID in order
   235→
   236→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   237→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   238→
   239→    # If hash changed and not already present, inject at front
   240→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
   241→        order.insert(0, SYNTHESIS_ID)
   242→        result.injected = True
   243→
   244→    # Never auto-prune: synthesis::pending is only removed by explicit completion
   245→
   246→    return result
   247→
   248→
   249→__all__ = [
   250→    "SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX",
   251→    "SYNTHESIS_ID",
   252→    "StaleDimensionSyncResult",
   253→    "SynthesisSyncResult",
   254→    "UnscoredDimensionSyncResult",
   255→    "_current_unscored_ids",
   256→    "review_finding_snapshot_hash",
   257→    "sync_stale_dimensions",
   258→    "sync_synthesis_needed",
   259→    "sync_unscored_dimensions",
   260→]
   261→

    43→def _check_queue_order_guard(
    44→    state: dict,
    45→    patterns: list[str],
    46→    status: str,
    47→) -> bool:
    48→    """Warn and block if resolving items not at the front of the plan queue.
    49→
    50→    Returns True if blocked, False if OK to proceed.
    51→    Only applies when a living plan exists and status is 'fixed'.
    52→    """
    53→    if status != "fixed":
    54→        return False
    55→    try:
    56→        if not has_living_plan():
    57→            return False
    58→        plan = load_plan()
    59→        queue_order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    60→        if not queue_order:
    61→            return False
    62→
    63→        # Build the work queue to find what's at position 0
    64→        result = build_work_queue(
    65→            state,
    66→            options=QueueBuildOptions(
    67→                plan=plan,
    68→                count=1,
    69→                collapse_clusters=True,
    70→                include_subjective=True,
    71→            ),
    72→        )
    73→        if not result["items"]:
    74→            return False
    75→
    76→        front_item = result["items"][0]
    77→        front_id = front_item["id"]
    78→
    79→        # Collect IDs that are "at the front" — the item itself,
    80→        # or all members if it's a collapsed cluster
    81→        front_ids: set[str] = set()
    82→        if front_item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    83→            for member in front_item.get("members", []):
    84→                front_ids.add(member["id"])
    85→            front_ids.add(front_id)  # cluster name itself
    86→        else:
    87→            front_ids.add(front_id)
    88→
    89→        # Expand patterns — check if they're cluster names too
    90→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    91→        resolved_ids: set[str] = set()
    92→        for p in patterns:
    93→            if p in clusters:
    94→                resolved_ids.update(clusters[p].get("finding_ids", []))
    95→                resolved_ids.add(p)
    96→            else:
    97→                resolved_ids.add(p)
    98→
    99→        # Check if all resolved IDs are at the front
   100→        out_of_order = resolved_ids - front_ids
   101→        if not out_of_order:
   102→            return False
   103→
   104→        # Blocked — print guidance
   105→        print(colorize(
   106→            "\n  Queue order violation: these items are not next in the plan queue:\n",
   107→            "yellow",
   108→        ))
   109→        for fid in sorted(out_of_order):
   110→            print(f"    {fid}")
   111→        print(colorize(
   112→            f"\n  The current next item is: {front_id}",
   113→            "dim",
   114→        ))
   115→        print(colorize(
   116→            "  Items must be resolved in plan order. If you need to reprioritize:",
   117→            "dim",
   118→        ))
   119→        print(colorize(
   120→            "    desloppify plan move <pattern> --position top    # move to front",
   121→            "dim",
   122→        ))
   123→        print(colorize(
   124→            "    desloppify plan skip <pattern> --reason '...'    # skip for now",
   125→            "dim",
   126→        ))
   127→        print(colorize(
   128→            "    desloppify next                                  # see what's next\n",
   129→            "dim",
   130→        ))
   131→        return True
   132→    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
   133→        return False  # don't block on errors

   136→def _save_state_or_exit(state: dict, state_file: str) -> None:
   137→    """Persist state with a consistent CLI error boundary."""
   138→    try:

   140→    except OSError as exc:

   154→def cmd_resolve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   155→    """Resolve finding(s) matching one or more patterns."""
   156→    attestation = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   157→    _validate_resolve_inputs(args, attestation)
   158→
   159→    # Require meaningful notes for fixed status
   160→    if args.status == "fixed":
   161→        note = getattr(args, "note", None)
   162→        if not validate_note_length(note):
   163→            show_note_length_requirement(note)
   164→            return
   165→
   166→    state_file = state_path(args)
   167→    state = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   168→
   169→    # Enforce plan queue order — items must be resolved front-to-back
   170→    if _check_queue_order_guard(state, args.patterns, args.status):
   171→        return
   172→
   173→    _enforce_batch_wontfix_confirmation(
   174→        state,
   175→        args,
   176→        attestation=attestation,
   177→        resolve_all_patterns_fn=_resolve_all_patterns,
   178→    )
   179→    prev = _previous_score_snapshot(state)
   180→    prev_subjective_scores = {
   181→        str(dim): (coerce_assessment_score(payload) or 0.0)
   182→        for dim, payload in (state.get("subjective_assessments") or {}).items()
   183→        if isinstance(dim, str)
   184→    }
   185→
   186→    all_resolved = _resolve_all_patterns(state, args, attestation=attestation)
   187→    if not all_resolved:
   188→        status_label = "resolved" if args.status == "open" else "open"
   189→        print(
   190→            colorize(
   191→                f"No {status_label} findings matching: {' '.join(args.patterns)}",
   192→                "yellow",
   193→            )
   194→        )
   195→        return
   196→
   197→    _save_state_or_exit(state, state_file)
   198→
   199→    # Remove resolved items from the living plan queue (best-effort)
   200→    try:
   201→        if has_living_plan():
   202→            plan = load_plan()
   203→            purged = purge_ids(plan, all_resolved)
   204→            append_log_entry(
   205→                plan,
   206→                "resolve",
   207→                finding_ids=all_resolved,
   208→                actor="user",
   209→                note=getattr(args, "note", None),
   210→                detail={"status": args.status, "attestation": attestation},
   211→            )
   212→            if purged:
   213→                save_plan(plan)
   214→                print(colorize(f"  Plan updated: {purged} item(s) removed from queue.", "dim"))
   215→            else:

   341→def _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   342→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   343→    *,
   344→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   345→) -> int:
   346→    """Reset known subjective dimensions to 0 so the next scan starts fresh."""
   347→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   348→
   349→    reset_keys = {
   350→        key.strip()
   351→        for key in assessments
   352→        if isinstance(key, str) and key.strip()
   353→    }
   354→    reset_keys.update(_subjective_reset_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name))
   355→
   356→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   357→    for key in sorted(reset_keys):
   358→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   359→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   360→            payload["score"] = 0.0
   361→            payload["source"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   362→            payload["assessed_at"] = now
   363→            payload["reset_by"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   364→            payload["placeholder"] = True
   365→            payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   366→            payload.pop("components", None)
   367→            payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   368→            continue
   369→        assessments[key] = {
   370→            "score": 0.0,
   371→            "source": "scan_reset_subjective",
   372→            "assessed_at": now,
   373→            "reset_by": "scan_reset_subjective",
   374→            "placeholder": True,
   375→        }
   376→    return len(reset_keys)

   379→def _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   380→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   381→) -> int:
   382→    """Expire provisional manual-override assessments at scan start."""
   383→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   384→
   385→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   386→    expired = 0
   387→    for payload in assessments.values():
   388→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   389→            continue
   390→        if payload.get("provisional_override") is not True:
   391→            continue
   392→        payload["score"] = 0.0
   393→        payload["source"] = "manual_override_expired"
   394→        payload["assessed_at"] = now
   395→        payload["reset_by"] = "manual_override_expired"
   396→        payload["placeholder"] = True
   397→        payload.pop("provisional_override", None)
   398→        payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)
   399→        payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   400→        payload.pop("components", None)
   401→        payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   402→        expired += 1
   403→    return expired

   451→def _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(
   452→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   453→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   454→) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   455→    """Append stale exclude findings when excluded dirs are unreferenced."""
   456→    extra_exclusions = get_exclusions()
   457→    if not (extra_exclusions and runtime.lang and runtime.lang.file_finder):
   458→        return findings
   459→
   460→    scanned_files = runtime.lang.file_finder(runtime.path)
   461→    stale = _audit_excluded_dirs(
   462→        extra_exclusions, scanned_files, PROJECT_ROOT
   463→    )
   464→    if not stale:
   465→        return findings
   466→
   467→    augmented = list(findings)
   468→    augmented.extend(stale)
   469→    for stale_finding in stale:
   470→        print(colorize(f"  ℹ {stale_finding['summary']}", "dim"))
   471→    return augmented

   490→def run_scan_generation(
   491→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   492→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, object], dict[str, object] | None]:
   493→    """Run detector pipeline and return findings, potentials, and codebase metrics."""
   494→    enable_file_cache()
   495→    enable_parse_cache()
   496→    try:
   497→        findings, potentials = plan_mod.generate_findings(
   498→            runtime.path,
   499→            lang=runtime.lang,
   500→            options=PlanScanOptions(
   501→                include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   502→                zone_overrides=runtime.zone_overrides,
   503→                profile=runtime.profile,
   504→            ),
   505→        )
   506→    finally:
   507→        disable_parse_cache()
   508→        disable_file_cache()
   509→
   510→    codebase_metrics = _collect_codebase_metrics(runtime.lang, runtime.path)
   511→    _warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   512→        runtime.args, runtime.lang, runtime.path, codebase_metrics
   513→    )
   514→    findings = _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(findings, runtime)
   515→    decay_scans = _coerce_int(
   516→        runtime.config.get("wontfix_decay_scans"),
   517→        default=_WONTFIX_DECAY_SCANS_DEFAULT,
   518→    )
   519→    findings, monitored_wontfix = _augment_with_stale_wontfix_findings(
   520→        findings,
   521→        runtime,
   522→        decay_scans=max(decay_scans, 0),
   523→    )
   524→    potentials["stale_wontfix"] = monitored_wontfix
   525→    return findings, potentials, codebase_metrics

   528→def merge_scan_results(
   529→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   530→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   531→    potentials: dict[str, object],
   532→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, object] | None,
   533→) -> ScanMergeResult:
   534→    """Merge findings into persistent state and return diff + previous score snapshot."""
   535→    scan_path_rel = rel(str(runtime.path))
   536→    prev_scan_path = runtime.state.get("scan_path")
   537→    path_changed = prev_scan_path is not None and prev_scan_path != scan_path_rel
   538→
   539→    if not path_changed:
   540→        prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(runtime.state)
   541→    else:
   542→        prev = state_mod.ScoreSnapshot(None, None, None, None)
   543→    prev_dim_scores = (
   544→        runtime.state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if not path_changed else {}
   545→    )
   546→
   547→    if runtime.lang and runtime.lang.zone_map is not None:
   548→        runtime.state["zone_distribution"] = runtime.lang.zone_map.counts()
   549→    _persist_scan_coverage(runtime.state, runtime.lang)
   550→
   551→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   552→
   553→    diff = state_mod.merge_scan(
   554→        runtime.state,
   555→        findings,
   556→        options=state_mod.MergeScanOptions(
   557→            lang=runtime.lang.name if runtime.lang else None,
   558→            scan_path=scan_path_rel,
   559→            force_resolve=getattr(runtime.args, "force_resolve", False),
   560→            exclude=get_exclusions(),
   561→            potentials=potentials,
   562→            codebase_metrics=codebase_metrics,
   563→            include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   564→            ignore=runtime.config.get("ignore", []),
   565→            subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   566→        ),
   567→    )
   568→
   569→    issues_mod.expire_stale_holistic(
   570→        runtime.state, runtime.config.get("holistic_max_age_days", 30)
   571→    )
   572→    state_mod.save_state(
   573→        runtime.state,
   574→        runtime.state_path,
   575→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   576→    )
   577→
   578→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   579→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   580→
   581→    return ScanMergeResult(
   582→        diff=diff,
   583→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   584→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   585→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   586→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   587→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   588→    )
   589→
   590→
   591→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   592→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   593→    config: dict[str, object],
   594→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   595→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden finding counters."""
   596→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   597→        state_mod.resolve_finding_noise_settings(config)
   598→    )
   599→    findings_by_id = _state_findings(state)
   600→    open_findings = [
   601→        finding
   602→        for finding in state_mod.path_scoped_findings(
   603→            findings_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   604→        ).values()
   605→        if finding.get("status") == "open"
   606→    ]
   607→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(
   608→        open_findings,
   609→        budget=noise_budget,
   610→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   611→    )
   612→
   613→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   614→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   615→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   616→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   617→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   618→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   619→    )
   620→
   621→
   622→def persist_reminder_history(
   623→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   624→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   625→) -> None:
   626→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   627→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   628→        return
   629→
   630→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   631→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   632→    state_mod.save_state(
   633→        runtime.state,
   634→        runtime.state_path,
   635→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   636→    )

    36→_ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_ATTEST_EXAMPLE = (
    37→    "I validated this review was completed without awareness of overall score and is unbiased."
    38→)
    39→_ASSESSMENT_MODE_LABELS = {
    40→    "none": "findings-only (no assessments in payload)",
    41→    "trusted_internal": "trusted internal (durable scores)",
    42→    "attested_external": "attested external (durable scores)",
    43→    "manual_override": "manual override (provisional scores)",
    44→    "findings_only": "findings-only (assessments skipped)",
    45→}

    48→class ImportPayloadLoadError(ValueError):
    49→    """Raised when review import payload parsing/validation fails."""
    50→
    51→    def __init__(self, errors: list[str]) -> None:
    52→        cleaned = [str(error).strip() for error in errors if str(error).strip()]
    53→        self.errors = cleaned
    54→        message = "; ".join(cleaned) if cleaned else "import payload validation failed"
    55→        super().__init__(message)
    56→
    57→
    58→def _normalize_import_payload_shape(
    59→    payload: dict[str, Any],
    60→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload | None, list[str]]:
    61→    """Normalize payload into required-key contract with strict type checks."""
    62→    errors: list[str] = []
    63→    findings = payload.get("findings")
    64→    if not isinstance(findings, list):
    65→        errors.append("findings must be a JSON array")
    66→        findings = []
    67→
    68→    assessments = payload.get("assessments")
    69→    if assessments is None:
    70→        assessments = {}
    71→    elif not isinstance(assessments, dict):
    72→        errors.append("assessments must be an object when provided")
    73→        assessments = {}
    74→
    75→    reviewed_files = payload.get("reviewed_files")
    76→    normalized_reviewed_files: list[str] = []
    77→    if reviewed_files is None:
    78→        normalized_reviewed_files = []
    79→    elif isinstance(reviewed_files, list):
    80→        normalized_reviewed_files = [
    81→            str(item).strip()
    82→            for item in reviewed_files
    83→            if isinstance(item, str) and str(item).strip()
    84→        ]
    85→    else:
    86→        errors.append("reviewed_files must be an array when provided")
    87→
    88→    review_scope = payload.get("review_scope")
    89→    if review_scope is None:
    90→        review_scope = {}
    91→    elif not isinstance(review_scope, dict):
    92→        errors.append("review_scope must be an object when provided")
    93→        review_scope = {}
    94→
    95→    provenance = payload.get("provenance")
    96→    if provenance is None:
    97→        provenance = {}
    98→    elif not isinstance(provenance, dict):
    99→        errors.append("provenance must be an object when provided")
   100→        provenance = {}
   101→
   102→    dimension_notes = payload.get("dimension_notes")
   103→    if dimension_notes is None:
   104→        dimension_notes = {}
   105→    elif not isinstance(dimension_notes, dict):
   106→        errors.append("dimension_notes must be an object when provided")
   107→        dimension_notes = {}
   108→
   109→    policy = payload.get(_ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY)
   110→    normalized_policy = (
   111→        policy if isinstance(policy, dict) else AssessmentImportPolicyModel().to_dict()
   112→    )
   113→    if errors:
   114→        return None, errors
   115→    return (
   116→        {
   117→            "findings": findings,
   118→            "assessments": assessments,
   119→            "reviewed_files": normalized_reviewed_files,
   120→            "review_scope": review_scope,
   121→            "provenance": provenance,
   122→            "dimension_notes": dimension_notes,
   123→            [REDACTED],
   124→        },
   125→        [],
   126→    )
   127→
   128→
   129→def _default_blind_packet_path() -> Path:
   130→    return get_project_root() / ".desloppify" / "review_packet_blind.json"
   131→
   132→
   133→def _is_sha256_hex(raw: object) -> bool:
   134→    return (
   135→        isinstance(raw, str)
   136→        and len(raw) == 64
   137→        and all(ch in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for ch in raw)
   138→    )
   139→
   140→
   141→def _hash_file_sha256(path: Path) -> str | None:
   142→    try:
   143→        data = path.read_bytes()
   144→    except OSError:
   145→        return None
   146→    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
   147→
   148→
   149→def _resolve_packet_path(raw_path: object) -> Path | None:
   150→    if not isinstance(raw_path, str):
   151→        return None
   152→    text = raw_path.strip()
   153→    if not text:
   154→        return None
   155→    path = Path(text)
   156→    return path if path.is_absolute() else get_project_root() / path
   157→
   158→
   159→def _assessment_provenance_status(
   160→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   161→    *,
   162→    import_file: str,
   163→) -> AssessmentProvenanceModel:
   164→    """Evaluate whether assessments come from a trusted blind batch artifact."""
   165→    provenance = findings_data["provenance"]
   166→    if not provenance:
   167→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   168→            trusted=False,
   169→            reason="missing provenance metadata",
   170→            import_file=import_file,
   171→        )
   172→
   173→    kind = str(provenance.get("kind", "")).strip()
   174→    if kind != _BLIND_PROVENANCE_KIND:
   175→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   176→            trusted=False,
   177→            reason=f"unsupported provenance kind: {kind or '<missing>'}",
   178→            import_file=import_file,
   179→        )
   180→
   181→    if provenance.get("blind") is not True:
   182→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   183→            trusted=False,
   184→            reason="provenance is not marked blind=true",
   185→            import_file=import_file,
   186→        )
   187→
   188→    runner = str(provenance.get("runner", "")).strip().lower()
   189→    if runner not in _SUPPORTED_BLIND_REVIEW_RUNNERS:
   190→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   191→            trusted=False,
   192→            reason=f"unsupported runner in provenance: {runner or '<missing>'}",
   193→            import_file=import_file,
   194→        )
   195→
   196→    packet_hash = provenance.get("packet_sha256")
   197→    if not _is_sha256_hex(packet_hash):
   198→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   199→            trusted=False,
   200→            reason="missing or invalid packet_sha256 in provenance",
   201→            import_file=import_file,
   202→        )
   203→
   204→    packet_path = _resolve_packet_path(provenance.get("packet_path"))
   205→    if packet_path is None:
   206→        packet_path = _default_blind_packet_path()
   207→    if not packet_path.exists():
   208→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   209→            trusted=False,
   210→            reason=f"blind packet not found: {packet_path}",
   211→            import_file=import_file,
   212→        )
   213→    observed_hash = _hash_file_sha256(packet_path)
   214→    if observed_hash is None:
   215→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   216→            trusted=False,
   217→            reason=f"unable to hash blind packet: {packet_path}",
   218→            import_file=import_file,
   219→        )
   220→    if observed_hash != packet_hash:
   221→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   222→            trusted=False,
   223→            reason=(
   224→                "blind packet hash mismatch "
   225→                f"(expected {packet_hash[:12]}..., got {observed_hash[:12]}...)"
   226→            ),
   227→            import_file=import_file,
   228→        )
   229→
   230→    return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   231→        trusted=True,
   232→        reason="trusted blind subagent provenance",
   233→        runner=runner,
   234→        packet_path=str(packet_path),
   235→        packet_sha256=packet_hash,
   236→        import_file=import_file,
   237→    )
   238→
   239→
   240→def resolve_override_context(
   241→    *,
   242→    manual_override: bool,
   243→    manual_attest: str | None,
   244→    assessment_override: bool,
   245→    assessment_note: str | None,
   246→) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
   247→    """Support legacy assessment_* flags while preferring manual_* naming."""
   248→    override = bool(manual_override or assessment_override)
   249→    attest = (
   250→        manual_attest
   251→        if isinstance(manual_attest, str) and manual_attest.strip()
   252→        else assessment_note
   253→    )
   254→    if isinstance(attest, str):
   255→        attest = attest.strip()
   256→    return override, attest
   257→
   258→
   259→def _validate_attested_external_attestation(attest: str | None) -> str | None:
   260→    """Validate and normalize attestation text for attested external imports."""
   261→    if not isinstance(attest, str) or not attest.strip():
   262→        return None
   263→    text = attest.strip()
   264→    lowered = text.lower()
   265→    if all(phrase in lowered for phrase in _ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_REQUIRED_PHRASES):
   266→        return text
   267→    return None
   268→

   270→def _print_import_error_hints(
   271→    errors: list[str],
   272→    *,
   273→    import_file: str,
   274→    colorize_fn,
   275→) -> None:
   276→    """Print actionable retry commands for common import policy failures."""
   277→    joined = " ".join(err.lower() for err in errors)
   278→    quoted_import = shlex.quote(import_file)
   279→    import_cmd = (
   280→        "desloppify review --import "
   281→        f"{quoted_import} --attested-external --attest "
   282→        f"\"{_ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_ATTEST_EXAMPLE}\""
   283→    )
   284→    validate_cmd = (
   285→        "desloppify review --validate-import "
   286→        f"{quoted_import} --attested-external --attest "
   287→        f"\"{_ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_ATTEST_EXAMPLE}\""
   288→    )
   289→    findings_only_cmd = f"desloppify review --import {quoted_import}"
   290→
   291→    if "--attested-external requires --attest containing both" in joined:
   292→        print(
   293→            colorize_fn(
   294→                "  Hint: rerun with the required attestation template:",
   295→                "yellow",
   296→            ),
   297→            file=sys.stderr,
   298→        )
   299→        print(colorize_fn(f"    `{import_cmd}`", "dim"), file=sys.stderr)
   300→        print(
   301→            colorize_fn(
   302→                f"  Preflight without state changes: `{validate_cmd}`",
   303→                "dim",
   304→            ),
   305→            file=sys.stderr,
   306→        )
   307→        return
   308→
   309→    if (
   310→        "--attested-external requires valid blind packet provenance" in joined
   311→        or "supports runner='claude'" in joined
   312→    ):
   313→        print(
   314→            colorize_fn(
   315→                "  Hint: if provenance is valid, rerun with:",
   316→                "yellow",
   317→            ),
   318→            file=sys.stderr,
   319→        )
   320→        print(colorize_fn(f"    `{import_cmd}`", "dim"), file=sys.stderr)
   321→        print(
   322→            colorize_fn(
   323→                f"  Preflight without state changes: `{validate_cmd}`",
   324→                "dim",
   325→            ),
   326→            file=sys.stderr,
   327→        )
   328→        print(
   329→            colorize_fn(
   330→                f"  Findings-only fallback: `{findings_only_cmd}`",
   331→                "dim",
   332→            ),
   333→            file=sys.stderr,
   334→        )

   337→def _apply_assessment_import_policy(
   338→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   339→    *,
   340→    import_file: str,
   341→    attested_external: bool,
   342→    attested_attest: str | None,
   343→    manual_override: bool,
   344→    manual_attest: str | None,
   345→    trusted_assessment_source: bool,
   346→    trusted_assessment_label: str | None,
   347→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload | None, list[str]]:
   348→    """Apply trust gating for assessment imports (findings import always allowed)."""
   349→    assessments = findings_data["assessments"]
   350→    has_assessments = bool(assessments)
   351→    assessment_count = len(assessments) if has_assessments else 0
   352→    provenance_status = _assessment_provenance_status(
   353→        findings_data, import_file=import_file
   354→    )
   355→    policy = AssessmentImportPolicyModel(
   356→        assessments_present=has_assessments,
   357→        assessment_count=int(assessment_count),
   358→        trusted=False,
   359→        mode="none",
   360→        reason="",
   361→        provenance=provenance_status,
   362→    )
   363→
   364→    def _attach_policy(payload: ReviewImportPayload) -> ReviewImportPayload:
   365→        normalized = dict(payload)
   366→        normalized[_ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY] = policy.to_dict()
   367→        return normalized
   368→
   369→    if not has_assessments:
   370→        return _attach_policy(findings_data), []
   371→
   372→    if trusted_assessment_source:
   373→        policy = replace(
   374→            policy,
   375→            mode="trusted_internal",
   376→            trusted=True,
   377→            reason=(trusted_assessment_label or "trusted internal run-batches import"),
   378→        )
   379→        return _attach_policy(findings_data), []
   380→
   381→    if attested_external:
   382→        normalized_attest = _validate_attested_external_attestation(attested_attest)
   383→        if normalized_attest is None:
   384→            return None, [
   385→                "--attested-external requires --attest containing both "
   386→                "'without awareness' and 'unbiased'"
   387→            ]
   388→        if provenance_status.trusted is not True:
   389→            return None, [
   390→                "--attested-external requires valid blind packet provenance "
   391→                f"(current status: {provenance_status.reason or 'untrusted provenance'})"
   392→            ]
   393→        runner = provenance_status.runner.strip().lower()
   394→        if runner not in _ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_RUNNERS:
   395→            return None, [
   396→                "--attested-external currently supports runner='claude' provenance only"
   397→            ]
   398→        policy = replace(
   399→            policy,
   400→            mode="attested_external",
   401→            trusted=True,
   402→            reason="attested external blind subagent provenance",
   403→            attest=normalized_attest,
   404→        )
   405→        return _attach_policy(findings_data), []
   406→
   407→    if manual_override:
   408→        if not isinstance(manual_attest, str) or not manual_attest.strip():
   409→            return None, ["--manual-override requires --attest"]
   410→        policy = replace(
   411→            policy,
   412→            mode="manual_override",
   413→            reason="manual override attested by operator",
   414→            attest=manual_attest.strip(),
   415→        )
   416→        return _attach_policy(findings_data), []
   417→
   418→    policy = replace(policy, mode="findings_only")
   419→    if findings_data["provenance"]:
   420→        provenance_reason = provenance_status.reason.strip()
   421→        if provenance_status.trusted is True:
   422→            policy = replace(
   423→                policy,
   424→                reason=(
   425→                    "external imports cannot self-attest trust even when provenance appears valid; "
   426→                    "run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   427→                ),
   428→            )
   429→        elif provenance_reason:
   430→            policy = replace(
   431→                policy,
   432→                reason=(
   433→                    "external imports cannot self-attest trust "
   434→                    f"({provenance_reason}); run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   435→                ),
   436→            )
   437→        else:
   438→            policy = replace(
   439→                policy,
   440→                reason=(
   441→                    "external imports cannot self-attest trust; "
   442→                    "run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   443→                ),
   444→            )
   445→    else:
   446→        policy = replace(
   447→            policy,
   448→            reason="missing trusted run-batches source; imported findings only",
   449→        )
   450→    payload = dict(findings_data)
   451→    payload["assessments"] = {}
   452→    payload[_ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY] = policy.to_dict()
   453→    return payload, []
   454→
   455→
   456→def _has_non_empty_strings(items: object) -> bool:
   457→    """Return True when ``items`` is a list with at least one non-empty string."""
   458→    return isinstance(items, list) and any(
   459→        isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in items
   460→    )
   461→
   462→
   463→def _validate_holistic_findings_schema(
   464→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   465→    *,
   466→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   467→) -> list[str]:
   468→    """Validate strict holistic finding schema expected by issue import."""
   469→    findings = findings_data["findings"]
   470→
   471→    allowed_dimensions: set[str] = set()
   472→    if isinstance(lang_name, str) and lang_name.strip():
   473→        _, dimension_prompts, _ = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang_name)
   474→        allowed_dimensions = set(dimension_prompts)
   475→
   476→    errors: list[str] = []
   477→    for idx, entry in enumerate(findings):
   478→        _normalized: ReviewFindingPayload | None
   479→        _normalized, entry_errors = validate_review_finding_payload(
   480→            entry,
   481→            label=f"findings[{idx}]",
   482→            allowed_dimensions=allowed_dimensions or None,
   483→            allow_dismissed=True,
   484→        )
   485→        for message in entry_errors:
   486→            if (
   487→                "is not allowed" in message
   488→                and lang_name
   489→                and "dimension '" in message
   490→            ):
   491→                message = message.replace(
   492→                    "is not allowed",
   493→                    f"is not valid for language '{lang_name}'",
   494→                )
   495→            errors.append(message)
   496→    return errors
   497→
   498→
   499→def _feedback_dimensions_from_findings(findings: object) -> set[str]:
   500→    """Return dimensions with explicit improvement guidance in findings payload."""
   501→    if not isinstance(findings, list):
   502→        return set()
   503→    dims: set[str] = set()
   504→    for entry in findings:
   505→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   506→            continue
   507→        dim = entry.get("dimension")
   508→        if not isinstance(dim, str) or not dim.strip():
   509→            continue
   510→        suggestion = entry.get("suggestion")
   511→        if isinstance(suggestion, str) and suggestion.strip():
   512→            dims.add(dim.strip())
   513→    return dims
   514→
   515→
   516→def _feedback_dimensions_from_dimension_notes(dimension_notes: object) -> set[str]:
   517→    """Return dimensions with concrete review evidence in dimension_notes payload."""
   518→    if not isinstance(dimension_notes, dict):
   519→        return set()
   520→    dims: set[str] = set()
   521→    for dim, note in dimension_notes.items():
   522→        if not isinstance(dim, str) or not dim.strip():
   523→            continue
   524→        if not isinstance(note, dict):
   525→            continue
   526→        if not _has_non_empty_strings(note.get("evidence")):
   527→            continue
   528→        dims.add(dim.strip())
   529→    return dims
   530→
   531→
   532→def _validate_assessment_feedback(
   533→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   534→) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
   535→    """Return dimensions missing required feedback and required low-score findings."""
   536→    assessments = findings_data["assessments"]
   537→    if not assessments:
   538→        return [], []
   539→
   540→    finding_dims = _feedback_dimensions_from_findings(findings_data["findings"])
   541→    feedback_dims = set(finding_dims)
   542→    feedback_dims.update(
   543→        _feedback_dimensions_from_dimension_notes(findings_data["dimension_notes"])
   544→    )
   545→    missing_feedback: list[str] = []
   546→    missing_low_score_findings: list[str] = []
   547→    for dim_name, payload in assessments.items():
   548→        if not isinstance(dim_name, str) or not dim_name.strip():
   549→            continue
   550→        score = coerce_assessment_score(payload)
   551→        if score is None:
   552→            continue
   553→        if score_requires_dimension_finding(score) and dim_name not in finding_dims:
   554→            missing_low_score_findings.append(f"{dim_name} ({score:.1f})")
   555→        if score_requires_explicit_feedback(score) and dim_name not in feedback_dims:
   556→            missing_feedback.append(f"{dim_name} ({score:.1f})")
   557→    return sorted(missing_feedback), sorted(missing_low_score_findings)
   558→
   559→
   560→def _parse_and_validate_import(
   561→    import_file: str,
   562→    *,
   563→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   564→    allow_partial: bool = False,
   565→    trusted_assessment_source: bool = False,
   566→    trusted_assessment_label: str | None = None,
   567→    attested_external: bool = False,
   568→    manual_override: bool = False,
   569→    manual_attest: str | None = None,
   570→    assessment_override: bool = False,
   571→    assessment_note: str | None = None,
   572→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload | None, list[str]]:
   573→    """Parse and validate a review import file (pure function).
   574→
   575→    Returns ``(data, errors)`` where *data* is the normalized payload on
   576→    success, or ``None`` when errors prevent import.
   577→    """
   578→    findings_path = Path(import_file)
   579→    if not findings_path.exists():
   580→        return None, [f"file not found: {import_file}"]
   581→    try:
   582→        findings_data = json.loads(findings_path.read_text())
   583→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as exc:
   584→        return None, [f"error reading findings: {exc}"]
   585→
   586→    if isinstance(findings_data, list):
   587→        findings_data = {"findings": findings_data}
   588→
   589→    if not isinstance(findings_data, dict):
   590→        return None, ["findings file must contain a JSON array or object"]
   591→
   592→    if "findings" not in findings_data:
   593→        return None, ["findings object must contain a 'findings' key"]
   594→    normalized_findings_data, shape_errors = _normalize_import_payload_shape(
   595→        findings_data
   596→    )
   597→    if shape_errors:
   598→        return None, shape_errors
   599→    assert normalized_findings_data is not None
   600→
   601→    override_enabled, override_attest = resolve_override_context(
   602→        manual_override=manual_override,
   603→        manual_attest=manual_attest,
   604→        assessment_override=assessment_override,
   605→        assessment_note=assessment_note,
   606→    )
   607→    if attested_external and override_enabled:
   608→        return None, [
   609→            "--attested-external cannot be combined with --manual-override"
   610→        ]
   611→    if attested_external and allow_partial:
   612→        return None, [
   613→            "--attested-external cannot be combined with --allow-partial; "
   614→            "attested score imports require fully valid findings payloads"
   615→        ]
   616→    if override_enabled and allow_partial:
   617→        return None, [
   618→            "--manual-override cannot be combined with --allow-partial; "
   619→            "manual score imports require fully valid findings payloads"
   620→        ]
   621→    findings_data, policy_errors = _apply_assessment_import_policy(
   622→        normalized_findings_data,
   623→        import_file=import_file,
   624→        attested_external=attested_external,
   625→        attested_attest=override_attest,
   626→        manual_override=override_enabled,
   627→        manual_attest=override_attest,
   628→        trusted_assessment_source=trusted_assessment_source,
   629→        trusted_assessment_label=trusted_assessment_label,
   630→    )
   631→    if policy_errors:
   632→        return None, policy_errors
   633→    assert findings_data is not None
   634→
   635→    missing_feedback, missing_low_score_findings = _validate_assessment_feedback(
   636→        findings_data
   637→    )
   638→    if missing_low_score_findings:
   639→        if override_enabled:
   640→            if not isinstance(override_attest, str) or not override_attest.strip():
   641→                return None, ["--manual-override requires --attest"]
   642→            return findings_data, []
   643→        return None, [
   644→            f"assessments below {LOW_SCORE_FINDING_THRESHOLD:.1f} must include at "
   645→            "least one finding for that same dimension with a concrete suggestion. "
   646→            f"Missing: {', '.join(missing_low_score_findings)}"
   647→        ]
   648→
   649→    if missing_feedback:
   650→        if override_enabled:
   651→            if not isinstance(override_attest, str) or not override_attest.strip():
   652→                return None, ["--manual-override requires --attest"]
   653→            return findings_data, []
   654→        return None, [
   655→            f"assessments below {ASSESSMENT_FEEDBACK_THRESHOLD:.1f} must include explicit feedback "
   656→            "(finding with same dimension and non-empty suggestion, or "
   657→            "dimension_notes evidence for that dimension). "
   658→            f"Missing: {', '.join(missing_feedback)}"
   659→        ]
   660→
   661→    schema_errors = _validate_holistic_findings_schema(
   662→        findings_data,
   663→        lang_name=lang_name,
   664→    )
   665→    if schema_errors and not allow_partial:
   666→        visible_errors = schema_errors[:10]
   667→        remaining = len(schema_errors) - len(visible_errors)
   668→        errors = [
   669→            "findings schema validation failed for holistic import. "
   670→            "Fix payload or rerun with --allow-partial to continue."
   671→        ]
   672→        errors.extend(visible_errors)
   673→        if remaining > 0:
   674→            errors.append(f"... {remaining} additional schema error(s) omitted")
   675→        return None, errors
   676→
   677→    return findings_data, []

1→"""Plan persistence — load/save with atomic writes."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import json
     6→import logging
     7→import shutil
     8→import sys
     9→from pathlib import Path
    10→
    11→from desloppify.core.discovery_api import safe_write_text
    12→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import (
    13→    PLAN_VERSION,
    14→    PlanModel,
    15→    empty_plan,
    16→    ensure_plan_defaults,
    17→    validate_plan,
    18→)
    19→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import STATE_DIR, json_default
    20→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import utc_now
    21→
    22→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    23→
    24→PLAN_FILE = STATE_DIR / "plan.json"
    25→
    26→
    27→def load_plan(path: Path | None = None) -> PlanModel:
    28→    """Load plan from disk, or return empty plan on missing/corruption."""
    29→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
    30→    if not plan_path.exists():
    31→        return empty_plan()
    32→
    33→    try:
    34→        data = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    35→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as ex:
    36→        # Try backup before giving up
    37→        backup = plan_path.with_suffix(".json.bak")
    38→        if backup.exists():
    39→            try:
    40→                data = json.loads(backup.read_text())
    41→                logger.warning("Plan file corrupted (%s), loaded from backup.", ex)
    42→                print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}), loaded from backup.", file=sys.stderr)
    43→                # Fall through to validation below
    44→            except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as backup_ex:
    45→                logger.warning("Plan file and backup both corrupted: %s / %s", ex, backup_ex)
    46→                print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    47→                return empty_plan()
    48→        else:
    49→            logger.warning("Plan file corrupted (%s). Starting fresh.", ex)
    50→            print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    51→            return empty_plan()
    52→
    53→    if not isinstance(data, dict):
    54→        logger.warning("Plan file root is not a JSON object. Starting fresh.")
    55→        print("  Warning: Plan file root must be a JSON object. Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    56→        return empty_plan()
    57→
    58→    version = data.get("version", 1)
    59→    if version > PLAN_VERSION:
    60→        logger.warning("Plan file version %d > supported %d.", version, PLAN_VERSION)
    61→        print(
    62→            f"  Warning: Plan file version {version} is newer than supported "
    63→            f"({PLAN_VERSION}). Some features may not work correctly.",
    64→            file=sys.stderr,
    65→        )
    66→
    67→    ensure_plan_defaults(data)
    68→    try:
    69→        validate_plan(data)
    70→    except ValueError as ex:
    71→        logger.warning("Plan invariants invalid (%s). Starting fresh.", ex)
    72→        print(f"  Warning: Plan invariants invalid ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    73→        return empty_plan()
    74→
    75→    return data  # type: ignore[return-value]
    76→
    77→
    78→def save_plan(plan: PlanModel | dict, path: Path | None = None) -> None:
    79→    """Validate and save plan to disk atomically."""
    80→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    81→    plan["updated"] = utc_now()
    82→    validate_plan(plan)
    83→
    84→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
    85→    plan_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    86→
    87→    content = json.dumps(plan, indent=2, default=json_default) + "\n"
    88→
    89→    if plan_path.exists():
    90→        backup = plan_path.with_suffix(".json.bak")
    91→        try:
    92→            shutil.copy2(str(plan_path), str(backup))
    93→        except OSError as backup_ex:
    94→            logger.debug("Failed to create plan backup: %s", backup_ex)
    95→
    96→    try:
    97→        safe_write_text(plan_path, content)
    98→    except OSError as ex:
    99→        print(f"  Warning: Could not save plan: {ex}", file=sys.stderr)
   100→        raise
   101→
   102→
   103→def plan_path_for_state(state_path: Path) -> Path:
   104→    """Derive plan.json path from a state file path."""
   105→    return state_path.parent / "plan.json"
   106→
   107→
   108→def has_living_plan(path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
   109→    """Return True if a plan.json exists and has user intent."""
   110→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
   111→    if not plan_path.exists():
   112→        return False
   113→    plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   114→    return bool(
   115→        plan.get("queue_order")
   116→        or plan.get("overrides")
   117→        or plan.get("clusters")
   118→    )
   119→
   120→
   121→__all__ = [
   122→    "PLAN_FILE",
   123→    "has_living_plan",
   124→    "load_plan",
   125→    "plan_path_for_state",
   126→    "save_plan",
   127→]

     2→

    33→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    36→
    37→FINDING_ID_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z_]+::[a-f0-9]{8,}")
    38→
    39→
    40→def extract_finding_citations(text: str, valid_ids: set[str]) -> set[str]:
    41→    """Extract finding IDs cited in free text.
    42→
    43→    Matches full finding IDs (e.g. ``review::abcdef12``) or bare 8+ char
    44→    hex suffixes that correspond to a known finding.
    45→    """
    46→    cited: set[str] = set()
    47→    # Match full finding IDs
    48→    for match in FINDING_ID_RE.finditer(text):
    49→        candidate = match.group()
    50→        if candidate in valid_ids:
    51→            cited.add(candidate)
    52→    # Match 8+ char hex suffixes
    53→    for token in re.findall(r"[0-9a-f]{8,}", text):
    54→        for valid_id in valid_ids:
    55→            if valid_id.endswith("::" + token):
    56→                cited.add(valid_id)
    57→                break
    58→    return cited
    59→
