    65→def last_real_review_timestamp(state: dict) -> str | None:
    66→    """ISO timestamp of most recent genuine review import (not manual override/scan reset)."""
    67→    REAL_MODES = {"holistic", "per_file", "trusted_internal", "attested_external"}
    68→    audit = state.get("assessment_import_audit", [])
    69→    if isinstance(audit, list):
    70→        for entry in reversed(audit):
    71→            if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("mode") in REAL_MODES:
    72→                ts = entry.get("timestamp")
    73→                if ts:
    74→                    return str(ts)
    75→    holistic = (state.get("review_cache") or {}).get("holistic")
    76→    if isinstance(holistic, dict):
    77→        return holistic.get("reviewed_at")
    78→    return None
    79→
    80→
    81→def detect_recurring_patterns(
    82→    open_findings: dict[str, dict],
    83→    resolved_findings: dict[str, dict],
    84→) -> dict[str, dict]:
    85→    """Detect dimensions with both resolved AND current open findings.
    86→
    87→    Returns ``{dimension: {"open": [ids], "resolved": [ids]}}``.
    88→    A dimension with both resolved and open findings signals a potential
    89→    loop — similar issues recur after previous fixes.
    90→    """
    91→    def _dimension(f: dict) -> str:
    92→        detail = f.get("detail", {})
    93→        if isinstance(detail, dict):
    94→            return detail.get("dimension", "")
    95→        return ""
    96→
    97→    open_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    98→    for fid, f in open_findings.items():
    99→        dim = _dimension(f)
   100→        if dim:
   101→            open_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
   102→
   103→    resolved_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   104→    for fid, f in resolved_findings.items():
   105→        dim = _dimension(f)
   106→        if dim:
   107→            resolved_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
   108→
   109→    recurring: dict[str, dict] = {}
   110→    for dim in set(open_by_dim) & set(resolved_by_dim):
   111→        recurring[dim] = {
   112→            "open": open_by_dim[dim],
   113→            "resolved": resolved_by_dim[dim],
   114→        }
   115→    return recurring
   116→
   117→
   118→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   119→# Data types
   120→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   121→
   122→@dataclass
   123→class SynthesisInput:
   124→    """All data the LLM needs to produce/update epics."""
   125→
   126→    open_findings: dict[str, dict]       # id -> finding (review + concerns)
   127→    mechanical_findings: dict[str, dict]  # id -> finding (non-review, for context)
   128→    existing_epics: dict[str, Cluster]    # current synthesis-clusters to update
   129→    dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]      # for context
   130→    new_since_last: set[str]             # finding IDs new since last synthesis
   131→    resolved_since_last: set[str]        # finding IDs resolved since last
   132→    previously_dismissed: list[str]      # IDs dismissed in prior synthesis
   133→    synthesis_version: int               # next version number
   134→    resolved_findings: dict[str, dict]   # full finding objects for resolved IDs
   135→    completed_clusters: list[dict]       # clusters completed since last synthesis
   136→
   137→
   138→@dataclass
   139→class DismissedFinding:
   140→    """A finding the LLM says doesn't make sense."""
   141→
   142→    finding_id: str
   143→    reason: str
   144→
   145→
   146→@dataclass
   147→class ContradictionNote:
   148→    """Record of a resolved contradiction."""
   149→
   150→    kept: str
   151→    dismissed: str
   152→    reason: str
   153→
   154→
   155→@dataclass
   156→class SynthesisResult:
   157→    """Parsed and validated LLM synthesis output."""
   158→
   159→    strategy_summary: str
   160→    epics: list[dict]
   161→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
   162→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = field(default_factory=list)
   163→    priority_rationale: str = ""
   164→
   165→
   166→@dataclass
   167→class SynthesisMutationResult:
   168→    """What changed when synthesis was applied to the plan."""
   169→
   170→    epics_created: int = 0
   171→    epics_updated: int = 0
   172→    epics_completed: int = 0
   173→    findings_dismissed: int = 0
   174→    findings_reassigned: int = 0
   175→    strategy_summary: str = ""
   176→    synthesis_version: int = 0
   177→    dry_run: bool = False
   178→
   179→
   180→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   181→# Input collection
   182→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   183→
   184→def collect_synthesis_input(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> SynthesisInput:
   185→    """Gather all data needed for the synthesis LLM prompt."""
   186→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   187→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   188→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   189→    epics = synthesis_clusters(plan)
   190→
   191→    open_review: dict[str, dict] = {}
   192→    open_mechanical: dict[str, dict] = {}
   193→    for fid, f in findings.items():
   194→        if f.get("status") != "open":
   195→            continue
   196→        if f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns"):
   197→            open_review[fid] = f
   198→        else:
   199→            open_mechanical[fid] = f
   200→
   201→    synthesized_ids = set(meta.get("synthesized_ids", []))
   202→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
   203→    new_since = current_review_ids - synthesized_ids
   204→    resolved_since = synthesized_ids - current_review_ids
   205→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
   206→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   207→
   208→    # Resolved finding objects (for REFLECT stage)
   209→    resolved_finding_objs = {
   210→        fid: findings[fid] for fid in resolved_since if fid in findings
   211→    }
   212→
   213→    # Completed clusters since last synthesis completion
   214→    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
   215→    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
   216→    if last_completed:
   217→        recent_completed = [
   218→            c for c in all_completed
   219→            if c.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
   220→        ]
   221→    else:
   222→        recent_completed = list(all_completed)
   223→
   224→    return SynthesisInput(
   225→        open_findings=open_review,
   226→        mechanical_findings=open_mechanical,
   227→        existing_epics=dict(epics),
   228→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   229→        new_since_last=new_since,
   230→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   231→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   232→        synthesis_version=version,
   233→        resolved_findings=resolved_finding_objs,
   234→        completed_clusters=recent_completed,
   235→    )
   236→
   237→
   238→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   239→# Prompt construction
   240→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   241→
   242→_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   243→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   244→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   245→
   246→Your plan should:
   247→- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   248→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   249→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   250→- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   251→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   252→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   253→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
   254→
   255→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   256→
   257→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   258→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   259→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   260→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   261→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   262→- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   263→- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   264→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   265→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   266→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   267→
   268→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
   269→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
   270→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   271→
   272→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   273→{
   274→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   275→  "epics": [
   276→    {
   277→      "name": "slug-name",
   278→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   279→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   280→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   281→      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   282→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   283→      "agent_safe": true,
   284→      "dependency_order": 1,
   285→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   286→      "status": "pending"
   287→    }
   288→  ],
   289→  "dismissed_findings": [
   290→    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
   291→  ],
   292→  "contradiction_notes": [
   293→    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
   294→  ],
   295→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   296→}
   297→"""
   298→
   299→
   300→def build_synthesis_prompt(si: SynthesisInput) -> str:
   301→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
   302→    parts: list[str] = []
   303→
   304→    # Section: existing epics
   305→    if si.existing_epics:
   306→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   307→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   308→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   309→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   310→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   311→            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   312→            parts.append(
   313→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   314→                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   315→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   316→            )
   317→        parts.append("")
   318→
   319→    # Section: what changed
   320→    if si.new_since_last:
   321→        parts.append(f"## New findings since last synthesis ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   322→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   323→            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   324→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   325→        parts.append("")
   326→
   327→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   328→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last synthesis ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   329→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   330→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   331→        parts.append("")
   332→
   333→    # Section: all open review findings
   334→    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   335→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   336→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   337→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   338→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   339→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   340→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   341→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   342→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   343→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   344→        if dimension:
   345→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   346→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   347→        if suggestion:
   348→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   349→    parts.append("")
   350→
   351→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   352→    if si.dimension_scores:
   353→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   354→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   355→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   356→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   357→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   358→                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   359→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   360→        parts.append("")
   361→
   362→    # Section: previously dismissed
   363→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   364→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   365→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   366→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   367→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   368→        parts.append("")
   369→
   370→    return "\n".join(parts)
   371→
   372→
   373→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   374→# Result parsing
   375→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   376→
   377→def parse_synthesis_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> SynthesisResult:
   378→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a SynthesisResult.
   379→
   380→    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   381→    """
   382→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   383→
   384→    epics: list[dict] = []
   385→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   386→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   387→            continue
   388→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   389→        if not name:
   390→            continue
   391→        # Validate direction
   392→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   393→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   394→            direction = "simplify"
   395→        # Filter to valid finding IDs
   396→        finding_ids = [
   397→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   398→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   399→        ]
   400→        dismissed = [
   401→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   402→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   403→        ]
   404→        action_steps = [
   405→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   406→            if isinstance(s, str)
   407→        ]
   408→
   409→        epics.append({
   410→            "name": name,
   411→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   412→            "direction": direction,
   413→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   414→            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   415→            "dismissed": dismissed,
   416→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   417→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   418→            "action_steps": action_steps,
   419→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   420→        })
   421→
   422→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
   423→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
   424→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   425→            continue
   426→        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
   427→        if fid in valid_ids:
   428→            dismissed_findings.append(
   429→                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   430→            )
   431→
   432→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   433→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   434→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   435→            continue
   436→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   437→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   438→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   439→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   440→        ))
   441→
   442→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   443→
   444→    return SynthesisResult(
   445→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   446→        epics=epics,
   447→        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
   448→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   449→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   450→    )
   451→
   452→
   453→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   454→# Plan mutation
   455→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   456→
   457→def apply_synthesis_to_plan(
   458→    plan: PlanModel,
   459→    state: StateModel,
   460→    synthesis: SynthesisResult,
   461→    *,
   462→    trigger: str = "manual",
   463→) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   464→    """Apply parsed synthesis result to the living plan.
   465→
   466→    1. Creates/updates synthesis-clusters in plan["clusters"]
   467→    2. Marks dismissed findings as synthesized_out skips
   468→    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   469→    4. Updates epic_synthesis_meta with snapshot hash
   470→    """
   471→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   472→    now = utc_now()
   473→    result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   474→    result.strategy_summary = synthesis.strategy_summary
   475→
   476→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   477→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   478→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   479→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   480→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   481→    result.synthesis_version = version
   482→
   483→    # --- Update/create synthesis-clusters ------------------------------------
   484→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   485→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   486→        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
   487→
   488→        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   489→        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   490→            # Update existing synthesis-cluster
   491→            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   492→            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
   493→            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
   494→            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
   495→            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
   496→            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
   497→            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
   498→            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
   499→            existing["updated_at"] = now
   500→            existing["synthesis_version"] = version
   501→            existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   502→            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
   503→            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
   504→                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
   505→            result.epics_updated += 1
   506→        else:
   507→            # Create new synthesis-cluster
   508→            cluster: Cluster = {
   509→                "name": epic_name,
   510→                "description": epic_data["thesis"],
   511→                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
   512→                "auto": True,
   513→                "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
   514→                "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
   515→                "user_modified": False,
   516→                "created_at": now,
   517→                "updated_at": now,
   518→                # Epic fields
   519→                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   520→                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   521→                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   522→                "supersedes": [],
   523→                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   524→                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   525→                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   526→                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   527→                "source_clusters": [],
   528→                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   529→                "synthesis_version": version,
   530→            }
   531→            clusters[epic_name] = cluster
   532→            result.epics_created += 1
   533→
   534→    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
   535→    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
   536→    for df in synthesis.dismissed_findings:
   537→        fid = df.finding_id
   538→        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   539→        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as synthesized_out
   540→        if fid in order:
   541→            order.remove(fid)
   542→        skipped[fid] = {
   543→            "finding_id": fid,
   544→            "kind": "synthesized_out",
   545→            "reason": df.reason,
   546→            "note": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   547→            "attestation": None,
   548→            "created_at": now,
   549→            "review_after": None,
   550→            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   551→        }
   552→        result.findings_dismissed += 1
   553→
   554→    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
   555→    for epic_data in synthesis.epics:
   556→        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
   557→            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
   558→                order.remove(fid)
   559→                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   560→                skipped[fid] = {
   561→                    "finding_id": fid,
   562→                    "kind": "synthesized_out",
   563→                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   564→                    "note": None,
   565→                    "attestation": None,
   566→                    "created_at": now,
   567→                    "review_after": None,
   568→                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   569→                }
   570→                result.findings_dismissed += 1
   571→
   572→    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
   573→    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
   574→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   575→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   576→        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
   577→            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
   578→                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
   579→                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   580→
   581→    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
   582→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
   583→    # Insert epic items at the front (after synthesis::pending if present)
   584→    new_order: list[str] = []
   585→    # Keep synthesis::pending at front if present (it will be pruned next sync)
   586→    if SYNTHESIS_ID in non_epic_items:
   587→        non_epic_items.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
   588→    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   589→    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
   590→    order.clear()
   591→    order.extend(new_order)
   592→
   593→    # --- Update synthesis meta -----------------------------------------------
   594→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   595→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   596→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   597→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   598→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   599→    )
   600→
   601→    plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {
   602→        "synthesized_ids": open_review_ids,
   603→        "last_run": now,
   604→        "version": version,
   605→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   606→        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   607→        "strategy_summary": synthesis.strategy_summary,
   608→        "trigger": trigger,
   609→    }
   610→    plan["updated"] = now
   611→
   612→    return result
   613→
   614→
   615→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   616→# Top-level orchestrator
   617→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   618→
   619→@dataclass
   620→class SynthesisDeps:
   621→    """Injectable dependencies for the synthesis engine."""
   622→
   623→    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
   624→
   625→
   626→def synthesize_epics(
   627→    plan: PlanModel,
   628→    state: StateModel,
   629→    *,
   630→    deps: SynthesisDeps | None = None,
   631→    dry_run: bool = False,
   632→    trigger: str = "manual",
   633→) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   634→    """Run epic synthesis: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   635→
   636→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   637→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   638→
   639→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   640→    """
   641→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   642→    si = collect_synthesis_input(plan, state)
   643→
   644→    prompt = build_synthesis_prompt(si)
   645→    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
   646→
   647→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   648→        result = SynthesisMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   649→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
   650→        return result
   651→
   652→    # Call LLM
   653→    try:
   654→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   655→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   656→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   657→        logger.error("Epic synthesis LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   658→        result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   659→        result.strategy_summary = f"Synthesis failed: {exc}"
   660→        return result
   661→
   662→    synthesis = parse_synthesis_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   663→    return apply_synthesis_to_plan(plan, state, synthesis, trigger=trigger)
   664→
   665→
   666→__all__ = [
   667→    "DismissedFinding",
   668→    "FINDING_ID_RE",
   669→    "SynthesisDeps",
   670→    "SynthesisInput",
   671→    "SynthesisMutationResult",

    49→    The assessment score is preserved (not zeroed) — only a fresh review import
    50→    should change dimension scores.  The stale marker tells the UI to prompt
    51→    for a re-review.
    52→    """
    53→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    54→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    55→        return
    56→
    57→    touched_dimensions: set[str] = set()
    58→    for finding in resolved_findings:
    59→        if finding.get("detector") != "review":
    60→            continue
    61→        dimension = str(finding.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")).strip()
    62→        if dimension:
    63→            touched_dimensions.add(dimension)
    64→
    65→    for dimension in sorted(touched_dimensions):
    66→        if dimension not in assessments:
    67→            continue
    68→
    69→        payload = assessments.get(dimension)
    70→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
    71→            payload["needs_review_refresh"] = True
    72→            payload["refresh_reason"] = f"review_finding_{status}"
    73→            payload["stale_since"] = now
    74→        else:
    75→            assessments[dimension] = {
    76→                "score": coerce_assessment_score(payload) or 0.0,
    77→                "needs_review_refresh": True,
    78→                "refresh_reason": f"review_finding_{status}",
    79→                "stale_since": now,
    80→            }
    81→
    82→
    83→def match_findings(
    84→    state: StateModel, pattern: str, status_filter: str = "open"
    85→) -> list[dict]:
    86→    """Return findings matching *pattern* with the given status."""
    87→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
    88→    return [
    89→        finding
    90→        for finding_id, finding in state["findings"].items()
    91→        if not finding.get("suppressed")
    92→        if (status_filter == "all" or finding["status"] == status_filter)
    93→        and _matches_pattern(finding_id, finding, pattern)
    94→    ]

Now I have a thorough understanding of the entire flow. Let me compile the analysis.

---

Here is a thorough analysis of how desloppify handles plan staleness after scans and review imports:

## 1. Does the plan track when it was last synthesized vs when the last scan happened?

**Partially, but not directly.** The `PlanModel` schema (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/schema.py`) has:

- `created` and `updated` timestamps (lines 76-77), where `updated` is bumped every time `save_plan()` is called (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/persistence.py`, line 81).
- `epic_synthesis_meta` dict (line 87) -- this is where synthesis metadata lives.

Inside `epic_synthesis_meta` (populated by `apply_synthesis_to_plan` in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/epic_synthesis.py`, lines 601-609):
```python
plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {
    "synthesized_ids": open_review_ids,
    "last_run": now,
    "version": version,
    "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
    "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
    "strategy_summary": synthesis.strategy_summary,
    "trigger": trigger,
}
```

And from `_apply_completion` in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/synthesize_handlers.py`, line 194:
```python
meta["last_completed_at"] = utc_now()
```

**However**, there is no field like `last_scan_at_synthesis_time` or `scan_count_at_synthesis`. The plan does NOT directly record which scan it was synthesized against. Instead, it uses a **content-based hash** approach: `finding_snapshot_hash` records a hash of the open review finding IDs at synthesis time, and this hash is compared against the current state to detect drift.

## 2. Is there any warning when a scan or review import happens that the plan may be stale?

**Yes, but only for a specific type of staleness: synthesis staleness.** In the scan workflow (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/scan_workflow.py`, lines 200-209):

```python
synth_sync = sync_synthesis_needed(plan, runtime.state)
if synth_sync.changes:
    dirty = True
    if synth_sync.injected:
        print(
            colorize(
                "  Plan: synthesis needed -- review findings changed since last synthesis.",
                "cyan",
            )
        )
```

This calls `sync_synthesis_needed` (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/stale_dimensions.py`, lines 222-246), which:
1. Computes the current `review_finding_snapshot_hash` (SHA-256 of sorted open review/concerns finding IDs).
2. Compares it to `epic_synthesis_meta.finding_snapshot_hash`.
3. If different and `synthesis::pending` is not already in the queue, injects `synthesis::pending` at the front of the queue.

Then `synthesis_phase_banner` in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/plan.py` (lines 79-95) renders a banner when `synthesis::pending` is in the queue:
```
"Synthesis needed -- review findings require analysis before fixing. Run: desloppify plan synthesize"
```

**For review imports: NO plan reconciliation happens.** Looking at `do_import` in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/review/import_cmd.py` -- it saves state (line 268) but never loads or reconciles the plan. There is zero `load_plan`, `save_plan`, `reconcile`, or `sync_synthesis_needed` call in the entire `review/` command directory. This is a significant gap -- after a review import changes review findings, the plan is not notified until the next scan.

## 3. What does reconciliation do after a scan -- does it just add/remove items or does it re-prioritize?

Reconciliation does **NOT re-prioritize**. It only handles structural cleanup. Looking at `reconcile_plan_after_scan` in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/reconcile.py` (lines 130-216), it does exactly three things:

**a) Supersede dead findings (lines 144-167):** Collects all finding IDs referenced by the plan (in `queue_order`, `skipped`, `overrides`, and cluster `finding_ids`). For each ID that is no longer alive (missing from state or status != "open"), it moves the ID to the `superseded` dict, removing it from `queue_order`, `skipped`, and all cluster membership lists. It also records remap candidates (other open findings from the same detector + file).

**b) Clean up epic clusters (lines 169-184):** For synthesis-clusters (names starting with `epic/`), removes dead finding IDs from `finding_ids`. If all findings in an epic are dead, deletes the entire epic cluster.

**c) Resurface stale temporary skips (lines 187-193):** Calls `resurface_stale_skips` to move temporary-skipped items back into the queue when their `review_after` scan count has been reached.

**d) Prune old superseded entries (lines 195-198):** Removes superseded entries older than 90 days (`SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS`).

The order within `queue_order` is **never changed** by reconciliation. Items just get removed (superseded) or added back (resurfaced). The relative priority of remaining items is preserved exactly.

## 4. Is there any concept of "plan is stale, needs re-synthesis" in the schema or state?

**Yes, via a synthetic queue item, not a schema field.** The concept is embodied by:

**The `synthesis::pending` sentinel ID.** This is defined in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/stale_dimensions.py` (line 20):
```python
SYNTHESIS_ID = "synthesis::pending"
```

When injected into the front of `queue_order`, it signals that synthesis is stale. The `sync_synthesis_needed` function (lines 222-246) handles injection:
- It compares the current `review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)` against `epic_synthesis_meta.finding_snapshot_hash`.
- If they differ and `synthesis::pending` is not already present, it inserts at position 0.
- It **never auto-prunes** -- only explicit completion via `_apply_completion` in the synthesize handler removes it.

There are also **stale subjective dimension sentinels** (`subjective::<slug>` IDs) managed by `sync_stale_dimensions` and `sync_unscored_dimensions`. These are injected/pruned based on:
- Whether subjective assessments have `needs_review_refresh: true` (set by `_mark_stale_on_mechanical_change` in merge.py when detectors that inform subjective dimensions have finding churn, or by `_mark_stale_assessments_on_review_resolve` when review findings are resolved).
- Whether assessments have `placeholder: true` (unscored dimensions after scan reset).

But there is **no** first-class `plan.is_stale` boolean or `plan.stale_reason` field in `PlanModel`. Staleness is purely represented by the presence of synthetic IDs in the queue.

## 5. What happens in the scan workflow and review import flow related to the plan?

### Scan workflow (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/scan_workflow.py`)

After `merge_scan_results` saves the updated state (line 576), it calls `_reconcile_plan_post_scan` (line 579). This function (lines 185-221) runs six reconciliation steps in sequence, inside a try/except that silently skips on errors:

1. **`_apply_plan_reconciliation`** -- calls `reconcile_plan_after_scan` (supersede dead findings, resurface skips, prune old superseded). Only runs if the plan has user content.
2. **`_sync_unscored_dimensions`** -- prepends `subjective::*` IDs for never-scored dimensions to the front of the queue.
3. **`_sync_stale_dimensions`** -- prunes no-longer-stale subjective IDs; appends newly-stale ones (only when no objective items remain).
4. **`_sync_auto_clusters`** -- regenerates automatic task clusters (including `auto/stale-review` for stale subjective dimensions, `auto/initial-review` for unscored ones).
5. **`sync_synthesis_needed`** -- injects `synthesis::pending` at front if review finding hash changed since last synthesis.
6. **`_seed_plan_start_scores` / `_clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty`** -- manages the score snapshot for tracking progress across a queue cycle.

If any step modifies the plan, `save_plan` is called at the end.

### Review import flow (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/review/import_cmd.py`)

**The review import does NOT touch the plan at all.** The `do_import` function:
1. Loads and validates the import payload
2. Imports findings into state via `review_mod.import_holistic_findings`
3. Handles assessment trust gating (trusted internal, attested external, manual override, findings-only)
4. Saves state
5. Prints score updates, narratives, and query output

There is no call to `load_plan`, `reconcile_plan_after_scan`, `sync_synthesis_needed`, or any plan-related function. This means:

- **After a review import creates new review findings**, the `synthesis::pending` injection will only happen on the NEXT scan.
- **After a review import resolves findings**, those findings remain as references in the plan's `queue_order` and clusters until the next scan's reconciliation supersedes them.
- The `auto/stale-review` cluster is not updated after review imports.

This is the most significant gap I found: **the review import flow is completely plan-unaware**.

### Resolve command (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/resolve/cmd.py`)

The resolve command **does** interact with the plan (lines 200-218):
- It calls `purge_ids(plan, all_resolved)` to remove resolved finding IDs from the queue.
- It logs a "resolve" entry in the execution log.
- It saves the plan.

But it does NOT trigger synthesis re-check or subjective dimension sync.

---

## Summary of gaps

| Scenario | Plan reconciliation? | Synthesis staleness check? | Subjective dimension sync? |
|---|---|---|---|
| After scan | Yes (full reconcile) | Yes (hash-based injection) | Yes (stale + unscored sync) |
| After review import | **No** | **No** | **No** |
| After resolve | Partial (purge IDs only) | **No** | **No** |

The plan's staleness model is **content-hash-based** (comparing review finding snapshot hashes) rather than **timestamp-based** (comparing plan.updated vs state.last_scan). There is no single "plan is stale" flag -- instead, staleness is encoded as synthetic queue items (`synthesis::pending`, `subjective::*`). And critically, the review import flow does not trigger any plan synchronization, leaving the plan potentially stale until the next scan.

1→"""Sync subjective dimensions into the plan queue.
     2→
     3→Two independent sync functions:
     4→
     5→- **sync_unscored_dimensions** — prepend never-scored (placeholder) dimensions
     6→  to the *front* of the queue unconditionally (onboarding priority).
     7→- **sync_stale_dimensions** — append stale (previously-scored) dimensions to
     8→  the *back* of the queue when no objective items remain.
     9→"""

    16→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel, ensure_plan_defaults

    20→SYNTHESIS_ID = "synthesis::pending"

    24→# Result dataclasses
    25→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    26→
    27→@dataclass
    28→class StaleDimensionSyncResult:
    29→    """What changed during a stale-dimension sync."""
    30→
    31→    injected: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    32→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    33→
    34→    @property
    35→    def changes(self) -> int:

    40→class UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
    41→    """What changed during an unscored-dimension sync."""
    42→
    43→    injected: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    44→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    46→    @property

    51→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    52→# ID helpers
    53→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    54→
    55→def _current_stale_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    56→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently stale."""
    57→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    58→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    59→        scorecard_subjective_entries,
    60→    )
    61→
    62→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
    63→    if not dim_scores:
    64→        return set()
    65→
    66→    stale: set[str] = set()
    67→    for entry in scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
    68→        if not entry.get("stale"):
    69→            continue
    70→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
    71→        if dim_key:
    72→            stale.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    73→    return stale
    74→
    75→
    76→def _current_unscored_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    77→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently unscored (placeholder).
    78→
    79→    Checks ``subjective_assessments`` directly because
    80→    ``scorecard_subjective_entries`` filters out placeholder dimensions
    81→    (they are hidden from the scorecard display).
    82→    """
    83→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    84→
    85→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    86→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    87→        return set()
    88→
    89→    unscored: set[str] = set()
    90→    for dim_key, payload in assessments.items():
    91→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    92→            continue
    93→        if not payload.get("placeholder"):
    94→            continue
    95→        if dim_key:
    96→            unscored.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    97→    return unscored
    98→

   100→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   101→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   102→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   103→
   104→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   105→    plan: PlanModel,
   106→    state: StateModel,
   107→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   108→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   109→
   110→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   111→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   112→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   113→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   114→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   115→    """
   116→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   117→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   118→    unscored_ids = _current_unscored_ids(state)
   119→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   120→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   121→
   122→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   123→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   124→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   125→        fid for fid in order
   126→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   127→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   128→        and fid not in stale_ids
   129→    ]
   130→    for fid in to_remove:
   131→        order.remove(fid)
   132→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   133→
   134→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs to front ----------------------------
   135→    existing = set(order)
   136→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   137→        if uid not in existing:
   138→            order.insert(0, uid)
   139→            result.injected.append(uid)
   140→
   141→    return result
   142→
   143→
   144→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   145→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   146→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   147→
   148→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   149→    plan: PlanModel,
   150→    state: StateModel,
   151→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   152→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale subjective dimensions.
   153→
   154→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   155→       longer stale and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned by
   156→       ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   157→    2. If no objective items remain after cleanup, inject all currently-stale
   158→       dimension IDs so the plan surfaces them as actionable work.
   159→    """
   160→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   161→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   162→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   163→    unscored_ids = _current_unscored_ids(state)
   164→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   165→
   166→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   167→    # Only prune IDs that are neither stale nor unscored.
   168→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   169→        fid for fid in order
   170→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   171→        and fid not in stale_ids
   172→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   173→    ]
   174→    for fid in to_remove:
   175→        order.remove(fid)
   176→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   177→
   178→    # --- Inject: populate when no objective items remain -----------------
   179→    has_real_items = any(fid for fid in order if not fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX))
   180→    if not has_real_items and stale_ids:
   181→        existing = set(order)
   182→        for sid in sorted(stale_ids):
   183→            if sid not in existing:
   184→                order.append(sid)
   185→                result.injected.append(sid)
   186→
   187→    return result
   188→
   189→
   190→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   191→# Synthesis snapshot hash + sync
   192→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   193→
   194→def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   195→    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
   196→
   197→    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
   198→    """
   199→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   200→    review_ids = sorted(
   201→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   202→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   203→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   204→    )
   205→    if not review_ids:
   206→        return ""
   207→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   208→
   209→
   210→@dataclass
   211→class SynthesisSyncResult:
   212→    """What changed during a synthesis sync."""
   213→
   214→    injected: bool = False
   215→    pruned: bool = False
   216→
   217→    @property
   218→    def changes(self) -> int:
   219→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   220→
   221→
   222→def sync_synthesis_needed(
   223→    plan: PlanModel,
   224→    state: StateModel,
   225→) -> SynthesisSyncResult:
   226→    """Inject ``synthesis::pending`` at front of queue when review findings change.
   227→
   228→    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion (``_apply_completion``) removes it.
   229→    """
   230→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   231→    result = SynthesisSyncResult()
   232→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   233→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   234→    already_present = SYNTHESIS_ID in order
   235→
   236→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   237→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   238→
   239→    # If hash changed and not already present, inject at front
   240→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
   241→        order.insert(0, SYNTHESIS_ID)
   242→        result.injected = True
   243→
   244→    # Never auto-prune: synthesis::pending is only removed by explicit completion
   245→
   246→    return result
   247→
   248→
   249→__all__ = [
   250→    "SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX",
   251→    "SYNTHESIS_ID",
   252→    "StaleDimensionSyncResult",
   253→    "SynthesisSyncResult",
   254→    "UnscoredDimensionSyncResult",

   257→    "sync_stale_dimensions",
   258→    "sync_synthesis_needed",

   130→                "cyan",
   131→            )
   132→        )
   133→    if sync.injected:
   134→        print(
   135→            colorize(
   136→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.injected)} stale subjective dimension(s) queued for refresh.",
   137→                "cyan",
   138→            )
   139→        )
   140→    return bool(sync.changes)

   148→def _seed_plan_start_scores(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel) -> bool:
   149→    """Set plan_start_scores when beginning a new queue cycle."""
   150→    if plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   151→        return False
   152→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   153→    if scores.strict is None:
   154→        return False
   155→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {
   156→        "strict": scores.strict,
   157→        "overall": scores.overall,
   158→        "objective": scores.objective,
   159→        "verified": scores.verified,
   160→    }
   161→    return True

   164→def _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(
   165→    state: state_mod.StateModel, plan: dict[str, object]
   166→) -> bool:
   167→    """Clear plan-start score snapshot once the queue is fully drained."""
   168→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   169→        return False
   170→
   171→    try:
   172→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import plan_aware_queue_count
   173→
   174→        queue_empty = plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan) == 0
   175→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   176→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   177→        return False
   178→    if not queue_empty:
   179→        return False
   180→    state["_plan_start_scores_for_reveal"] = dict(plan["plan_start_scores"])
   181→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
   182→    return True

   185→def _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime: "ScanRuntime") -> None:
   186→    """Reconcile plan queue metadata and stale subjective review dimensions."""
   187→    try:
   188→        plan_path = runtime.state_path.parent / "plan.json" if runtime.state_path else None
   189→        plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   190→        dirty = False
   191→
   192→        if _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan, runtime.state, reconcile_plan_after_scan):
   193→            dirty = True
   194→        if _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_unscored_dimensions):
   195→            dirty = True
   196→        if _sync_stale_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_stale_dimensions):
   197→            dirty = True
   198→        if _sync_auto_clusters(plan, runtime.state):
   199→            dirty = True
   200→        synth_sync = sync_synthesis_needed(plan, runtime.state)
   201→        if synth_sync.changes:
   202→            dirty = True
   203→            if synth_sync.injected:
   204→                print(
   205→                    colorize(
   206→                        "  Plan: synthesis needed — review findings changed since last synthesis.",
   207→                        "cyan",
   208→                    )
   209→                )
   210→        seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, runtime.state)
   211→        if seeded:
   212→            dirty = True
   213→        # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —
   214→        # never clear scores we just seeded in the same scan.
   215→        if not seeded and _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(runtime.state, plan):
   216→            dirty = True
   217→
   218→        if dirty:
   219→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   220→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   221→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)

   309→def _configure_lang_runtime(
   310→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   311→    config: dict[str, object],
   312→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   313→    lang: LangRun | None,
   314→) -> LangRun | None:
   315→    """Populate runtime context and threshold overrides for a selected language."""
   316→    if not lang:
   317→        return None
   318→
   319→    lang_options = resolve_lang_runtime_options(args, lang)
   320→    lang_settings = resolve_lang_settings(config, lang)
   321→    runtime_lang = make_lang_run(
   322→        lang,
   323→        overrides=LangRunOverrides(
   324→            review_cache=state.get("review_cache", {}),
   325→            review_max_age_days=config.get("review_max_age_days", 30),
   326→            runtime_settings=lang_settings,
   327→            runtime_options=lang_options,

   329→            props_threshold_override=config.get("props_threshold", 0),
   330→        ),
   331→    )

   333→    lang_capabilities = _state_lang_capabilities(state)
   334→    lang_capabilities[runtime_lang.name] = {
   335→        "fixers": sorted(runtime_lang.fixers.keys()),
   336→        "typecheck_cmd": runtime_lang.typecheck_cmd,
   337→    }

   341→def _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   342→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   343→    *,
   344→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   345→) -> int:
   346→    """Reset known subjective dimensions to 0 so the next scan starts fresh."""
   347→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   348→
   349→    reset_keys = {
   350→        key.strip()
   351→        for key in assessments
   352→        if isinstance(key, str) and key.strip()
   353→    }
   354→    reset_keys.update(_subjective_reset_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name))
   355→
   356→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   357→    for key in sorted(reset_keys):
   358→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   359→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   360→            payload["score"] = 0.0
   361→            payload["source"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   362→            payload["assessed_at"] = now
   363→            payload["reset_by"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   364→            payload["placeholder"] = True
   365→            payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   366→            payload.pop("components", None)
   367→            payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   368→            continue
   369→        assessments[key] = {
   370→            "score": 0.0,
   371→            "source": "scan_reset_subjective",
   372→            "assessed_at": now,
   373→            "reset_by": "scan_reset_subjective",
   374→            "placeholder": True,
   375→        }
   376→    return len(reset_keys)
   377→
   378→
   379→def _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   380→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   381→) -> int:
   382→    """Expire provisional manual-override assessments at scan start."""
   383→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   384→
   385→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   386→    expired = 0
   387→    for payload in assessments.values():
   388→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   389→            continue
   390→        if payload.get("provisional_override") is not True:
   391→            continue
   392→        payload["score"] = 0.0
   393→        payload["source"] = "manual_override_expired"
   394→        payload["assessed_at"] = now
   395→        payload["reset_by"] = "manual_override_expired"
   396→        payload["placeholder"] = True
   397→        payload.pop("provisional_override", None)
   398→        payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)
   399→        payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   400→        payload.pop("components", None)
   401→        payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   402→        expired += 1
   403→    return expired

   408→    runtime = command_runtime(args)

   411→    state_mod.ensure_state_defaults(state)

   417→        state

   420→        reset_subjective_count = _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   421→            state,

   423→        )
   424→
   425→    include_slow = not getattr(args, "skip_slow", False)
   426→    profile = _resolve_scan_profile(getattr(args, "profile", None), lang_config)
   427→    effective_include_slow = _effective_include_slow(include_slow, profile)
   428→
   429→    lang = _configure_lang_runtime(args, config, state, lang_config)
   430→    coverage_warnings = _seed_runtime_coverage_warnings(lang)
   431→    zone_overrides_raw = config.get("zone_overrides")
   432→    zone_overrides = zone_overrides_raw if isinstance(zone_overrides_raw, dict) else None
   433→
   434→    return ScanRuntime(
   435→        args=args,
   436→        state_path=state_file,
   437→        state=state,
   438→        path=path,
   439→        config=config,
   440→        lang=lang,

   442→        profile=profile,
   443→        effective_include_slow=effective_include_slow,

   451→def _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(
   452→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   453→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   454→) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   455→    """Append stale exclude findings when excluded dirs are unreferenced."""
   456→    extra_exclusions = get_exclusions()
   457→    if not (extra_exclusions and runtime.lang and runtime.lang.file_finder):
   458→        return findings
   459→
   460→    scanned_files = runtime.lang.file_finder(runtime.path)
   461→    stale = _audit_excluded_dirs(
   462→        extra_exclusions, scanned_files, PROJECT_ROOT
   463→    )
   464→    if not stale:
   465→        return findings
   466→
   467→    augmented = list(findings)
   468→    augmented.extend(stale)
   469→    for stale_finding in stale:
   470→        print(colorize(f"  ℹ {stale_finding['summary']}", "dim"))
   471→    return augmented

   479→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:

   490→def run_scan_generation(
   491→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   492→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, object], dict[str, object] | None]:
   493→    """Run detector pipeline and return findings, potentials, and codebase metrics."""
   494→    enable_file_cache()
   495→    enable_parse_cache()
   496→    try:
   497→        findings, potentials = plan_mod.generate_findings(
   498→            runtime.path,
   499→            lang=runtime.lang,
   500→            options=PlanScanOptions(
   501→                include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   502→                zone_overrides=runtime.zone_overrides,
   503→                profile=runtime.profile,
   504→            ),
   505→        )
   506→    finally:
   507→        disable_parse_cache()
   508→        disable_file_cache()
   509→
   510→    codebase_metrics = _collect_codebase_metrics(runtime.lang, runtime.path)
   511→    _warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   512→        runtime.args, runtime.lang, runtime.path, codebase_metrics
   513→    )
   514→    findings = _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(findings, runtime)
   515→    decay_scans = _coerce_int(
   516→        runtime.config.get("wontfix_decay_scans"),
   517→        default=_WONTFIX_DECAY_SCANS_DEFAULT,
   518→    )
   519→    findings, monitored_wontfix = _augment_with_stale_wontfix_findings(
   520→        findings,
   521→        runtime,
   522→        decay_scans=max(decay_scans, 0),
   523→    )
   524→    potentials["stale_wontfix"] = monitored_wontfix
   525→    return findings, potentials, codebase_metrics
   526→
   527→
   528→def merge_scan_results(
   529→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   530→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   531→    potentials: dict[str, object],
   532→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, object] | None,
   533→) -> ScanMergeResult:
   534→    """Merge findings into persistent state and return diff + previous score snapshot."""
   535→    scan_path_rel = rel(str(runtime.path))
   536→    prev_scan_path = runtime.state.get("scan_path")
   537→    path_changed = prev_scan_path is not None and prev_scan_path != scan_path_rel
   538→
   539→    if not path_changed:
   540→        prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(runtime.state)
   541→    else:
   542→        prev = state_mod.ScoreSnapshot(None, None, None, None)
   543→    prev_dim_scores = (
   544→        runtime.state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if not path_changed else {}
   545→    )
   546→
   547→    if runtime.lang and runtime.lang.zone_map is not None:
   548→        runtime.state["zone_distribution"] = runtime.lang.zone_map.counts()
   549→    _persist_scan_coverage(runtime.state, runtime.lang)
   550→
   551→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   552→
   553→    diff = state_mod.merge_scan(
   554→        runtime.state,
   555→        findings,
   556→        options=state_mod.MergeScanOptions(
   557→            lang=runtime.lang.name if runtime.lang else None,
   558→            scan_path=scan_path_rel,
   559→            force_resolve=getattr(runtime.args, "force_resolve", False),
   560→            exclude=get_exclusions(),
   561→            potentials=potentials,
   562→            codebase_metrics=codebase_metrics,
   563→            include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   564→            ignore=runtime.config.get("ignore", []),
   565→            subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   566→        ),
   567→    )
   568→
   569→    issues_mod.expire_stale_holistic(
   570→        runtime.state, runtime.config.get("holistic_max_age_days", 30)
   571→    )
   572→    state_mod.save_state(
   573→        runtime.state,
   574→        runtime.state_path,
   575→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   576→    )
   577→
   578→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   579→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   580→
   581→    return ScanMergeResult(
   582→        diff=diff,
   583→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   584→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   585→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   586→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   587→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   588→    )
   589→
   590→
   591→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   592→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   593→    config: dict[str, object],
   594→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   595→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden finding counters."""
   596→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   597→        state_mod.resolve_finding_noise_settings(config)
   598→    )
   599→    findings_by_id = _state_findings(state)
   600→    open_findings = [
   601→        finding
   602→        for finding in state_mod.path_scoped_findings(
   603→            findings_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   604→        ).values()
   605→        if finding.get("status") == "open"
   606→    ]
   607→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(
   608→        open_findings,
   609→        budget=noise_budget,
   610→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   611→    )
   612→
   613→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   614→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   615→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   616→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   617→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   618→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   619→    )
   620→
   621→
   622→def persist_reminder_history(
   623→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   624→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   625→) -> None:
   626→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   627→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   628→        return
   629→
   630→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   631→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   632→    state_mod.save_state(
   633→        runtime.state,
   634→        runtime.state_path,
   635→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   636→    )

    79→def synthesis_phase_banner(plan: PlanModel) -> str:
    80→    """Return a banner string when ``synthesis::pending`` is in the queue."""
    81→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    82→    if SYNTHESIS_ID not in plan.get("queue_order", []):
    83→        return ""
    84→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
    85→    stages = meta.get("synthesis_stages", {})
    86→    completed = [s for s in ("observe", "reflect", "organize") if s in stages]
    87→    if completed:
    88→        return (
    89→            f"Synthesis in progress ({len(completed)}/4 stages complete). "
    90→            "Run: desloppify plan synthesize"
    91→        )
    92→    return (
    93→        "Synthesis needed — review findings require analysis before fixing. "
    94→        "Run: desloppify plan synthesize"
    95→    )
    96→

    38→class ImportFlagValidationError(ValueError):
    39→    """Raised when review import CLI flags are mutually incompatible."""
    40→
    41→
    42→def _validate_import_flag_combos(
    43→    *,
    44→    attested_external: bool,
    45→    allow_partial: bool,
    46→    override_enabled: bool,
    47→    override_attest: str | None,
    48→) -> None:
    49→    """Fail fast on conflicting import flags to keep behavior explicit."""
    50→    if attested_external and override_enabled:
    51→        raise ImportFlagValidationError(
    52→            "--attested-external cannot be combined with --manual-override"
    53→        )
    54→    if attested_external and allow_partial:
    55→        raise ImportFlagValidationError(
    56→            "--attested-external cannot be combined with --allow-partial"
    57→        )
    58→    if override_enabled and allow_partial:
    59→        raise ImportFlagValidationError(
    60→            "--manual-override cannot be combined with --allow-partial"
    61→        )
    62→    if override_enabled and (
    63→        not isinstance(override_attest, str) or not override_attest.strip()
    64→    ):
    65→        raise ImportFlagValidationError("--manual-override requires --attest")
    66→
    67→
    68→def _imported_assessment_keys(findings_data: ReviewImportPayload) -> set[str]:
    69→    """Return normalized assessment dimension keys from payload."""
    70→    raw_assessments = findings_data["assessments"]
    71→    keys: set[str] = set()
    72→    for raw_key in raw_assessments:
    73→        normalized = normalize_dimension_name(str(raw_key))
    74→        if normalized:
    75→            keys.add(normalized)
    76→    return keys
    77→
    78→
    79→def _mark_manual_override_assessments_provisional(
    80→    state: dict,
    81→    *,
    82→    assessment_keys: set[str],
    83→) -> int:
    84→    """Mark imported manual override assessments as provisional until next scan."""
    85→    if not assessment_keys:
    86→        return 0
    87→    store = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    88→    if not isinstance(store, dict):
    89→        return 0
    90→
    91→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
    92→    expires_scan = int(state.get("scan_count", 0) or 0) + 1
    93→    marked = 0
    94→    for key in sorted(assessment_keys):
    95→        payload = store.get(key)
    96→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    97→            continue
    98→        payload["source"] = "manual_override"
    99→        payload["assessed_at"] = now
   100→        payload["provisional_override"] = True
   101→        payload["provisional_until_scan"] = expires_scan
   102→        payload.pop("placeholder", None)
   103→        marked += 1
   104→    return marked
   105→
   106→
   107→def _clear_provisional_override_flags(
   108→    state: dict,
   109→    *,
   110→    assessment_keys: set[str],
   111→) -> int:
   112→    """Clear provisional override flags when trusted internal assessments replace them."""
   113→    if not assessment_keys:
   114→        return 0
   115→    store = state.get("subjective_assessments")
   116→    if not isinstance(store, dict):
   117→        return 0
   118→
   119→    cleared = 0
   120→    for key in sorted(assessment_keys):
   121→        payload = store.get(key)
   122→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   123→            continue
   124→        if payload.pop("provisional_override", None) is not None:
   125→            cleared += 1
   126→        payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)
   127→        if payload.get("source") == "manual_override":
   128→            payload["source"] = "holistic"
   129→    return cleared

   199→    prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)

   201→    # Transactional import: only persist if all post-import guards pass.

   366→    try:

1→"""Plan persistence — load/save with atomic writes."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import json
     6→import logging
     7→import shutil
     8→import sys
     9→from pathlib import Path
    10→
    11→from desloppify.core.discovery_api import safe_write_text
    12→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import (
    13→    PLAN_VERSION,
    14→    PlanModel,
    15→    empty_plan,
    16→    ensure_plan_defaults,
    17→    validate_plan,
    18→)
    19→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import STATE_DIR, json_default
    20→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import utc_now
    21→
    22→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    23→
    24→PLAN_FILE = STATE_DIR / "plan.json"
    25→
    26→
    27→def load_plan(path: Path | None = None) -> PlanModel:
    28→    """Load plan from disk, or return empty plan on missing/corruption."""
    29→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
    30→    if not plan_path.exists():
    31→        return empty_plan()
    32→
    33→    try:
    34→        data = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    35→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as ex:
    36→        # Try backup before giving up
    37→        backup = plan_path.with_suffix(".json.bak")
    38→        if backup.exists():
    39→            try:
    40→                data = json.loads(backup.read_text())
    41→                logger.warning("Plan file corrupted (%s), loaded from backup.", ex)
    42→                print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}), loaded from backup.", file=sys.stderr)
    43→                # Fall through to validation below
    44→            except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as backup_ex:
    45→                logger.warning("Plan file and backup both corrupted: %s / %s", ex, backup_ex)
    46→                print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    47→                return empty_plan()
    48→        else:
    49→            logger.warning("Plan file corrupted (%s). Starting fresh.", ex)
    50→            print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    51→            return empty_plan()
    52→
    53→    if not isinstance(data, dict):
    54→        logger.warning("Plan file root is not a JSON object. Starting fresh.")
    55→        print("  Warning: Plan file root must be a JSON object. Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    56→        return empty_plan()
    57→
    58→    version = data.get("version", 1)
    59→    if version > PLAN_VERSION:
    60→        logger.warning("Plan file version %d > supported %d.", version, PLAN_VERSION)
    61→        print(
    62→            f"  Warning: Plan file version {version} is newer than supported "
    63→            f"({PLAN_VERSION}). Some features may not work correctly.",
    64→            file=sys.stderr,
    65→        )
    66→
    67→    ensure_plan_defaults(data)
    68→    try:
    69→        validate_plan(data)
    70→    except ValueError as ex:
    71→        logger.warning("Plan invariants invalid (%s). Starting fresh.", ex)
    72→        print(f"  Warning: Plan invariants invalid ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    73→        return empty_plan()
    74→
    75→    return data  # type: ignore[return-value]
    76→
    77→
    78→def save_plan(plan: PlanModel | dict, path: Path | None = None) -> None:
    79→    """Validate and save plan to disk atomically."""
    80→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    81→    plan["updated"] = utc_now()
    82→    validate_plan(plan)
    83→
    84→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
    85→    plan_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    86→
    87→    content = json.dumps(plan, indent=2, default=json_default) + "\n"
    88→
    89→    if plan_path.exists():
    90→        backup = plan_path.with_suffix(".json.bak")
    91→        try:
    92→            shutil.copy2(str(plan_path), str(backup))
    93→        except OSError as backup_ex:
    94→            logger.debug("Failed to create plan backup: %s", backup_ex)
    95→
    96→    try:
    97→        safe_write_text(plan_path, content)
    98→    except OSError as ex:
    99→        print(f"  Warning: Could not save plan: {ex}", file=sys.stderr)
   100→        raise
   101→
   102→
   103→def plan_path_for_state(state_path: Path) -> Path:
   104→    """Derive plan.json path from a state file path."""
   105→    return state_path.parent / "plan.json"
   106→
   107→
   108→def has_living_plan(path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
   109→    """Return True if a plan.json exists and has user intent."""
   110→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
   111→    if not plan_path.exists():
   112→        return False
   113→    plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   114→    return bool(
   115→        plan.get("queue_order")
   116→        or plan.get("overrides")
   117→        or plan.get("clusters")
   118→    )
   119→
   120→
   121→__all__ = [
   122→    "PLAN_FILE",
   123→    "has_living_plan",
   124→    "load_plan",
   125→    "plan_path_for_state",
   126→    "save_plan",
   127→]
   128→

   100→def _apply_plan_order(
   101→    items: list[dict],
   102→    plan: dict,
   103→    *,
   104→    include_skipped: bool = False,
   105→    cluster: str | None = None,
   106→) -> list[dict]:
   107→    """Reorder items according to the living plan.
   108→
   109→    1. Items in ``queue_order`` appear first, in that order.
   110→    2. Remaining items keep their mechanical sort.
   111→    3. Skipped items are appended last (or excluded).
   112→    4. Each item is annotated with plan metadata.
   113→    """
   114→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   115→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
   116→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
   117→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
   118→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
   119→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
   120→
   121→    # Build lookup
   122→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
   123→    for item in items:
   124→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
   125→
   126→    # Annotate items with plan metadata
   127→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
   128→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
   129→        if override.get("description"):
   130→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
   131→        if override.get("note"):
   132→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
   133→        if override.get("cluster"):
   134→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
   135→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   136→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
   137→                "name": cluster_name,
   138→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
   139→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
   140→                "sibling_ids": cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []),
   141→            }
   142→
   143→    # Split into ordered, remaining, skipped
   144→    ordered: list[dict] = []
   145→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
   146→    for fid in queue_order:
   147→        if fid in by_id and fid not in skipped_ids:
   148→            ordered.append(by_id[fid])
   149→            ordered_ids.add(fid)
   150→
   151→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
   152→    remaining: list[dict] = []
   153→    for item in items:
   154→        item_id = item["id"]
   155→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
   156→            continue
   157→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
   158→            skipped_items.append(item)
   159→        else:
   160→            remaining.append(item)
   161→
   162→    # Assign queue positions
   163→    result = ordered + remaining
   164→    if include_skipped:
   165→        result = result + skipped_items
   166→
   167→    for pos, item in enumerate(result):
   168→        item["queue_position"] = pos + 1
   169→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   170→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   171→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   172→            if skip_entry:
   173→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   174→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   175→                if skip_reason:
   176→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   177→
   178→    # Filter to cluster if requested
   179→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   180→    if effective_cluster:
   181→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   182→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   183→        if cluster_member_ids:
   184→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   185→
   186→    return result
   187→

    45→def _short_id(fid: str) -> str:
    46→    """Extract the 8-char hash suffix from a finding ID for compact display.
    47→
    48→    Finding IDs look like ``review::.::holistic::dim::identifier::abcdef12``.
    49→    Commands accept the hash suffix as a shorthand for the full ID.
    50→    """
    51→    if "::" in fid:
    52→        suffix = fid.rsplit("::", 1)[-1]
    53→        if len(suffix) >= 8:
    54→            return suffix[:8]
    55→    return fid
