    55→    similarity_threshold: float,
    56→) -> bool:
    57→    left_detail = left.get("detail", {})
    58→    right_detail = right.get("detail", {})
    59→    if left_detail.get("dimension") != right_detail.get("dimension"):
    60→        return False
    61→
    62→    left_summary = str(left.get("summary", "")).strip()
    63→    right_summary = str(right.get("summary", "")).strip()
    64→    similarity = _summary_similarity(left_summary, right_summary)
    65→
    66→    left_files = _related_files_set(left)
    67→    right_files = _related_files_set(right)
    68→    files_overlap = not left_files or not right_files or bool(left_files & right_files)
    69→
    70→    left_identifier = _parse_holistic_identifier(left.get("id", ""))
    71→    right_identifier = _parse_holistic_identifier(right.get("id", ""))
    72→    if left_identifier and right_identifier and left_identifier == right_identifier:
    73→        # Identifier match still requires at least one corroborating signal
    74→        return similarity >= 0.3 or files_overlap
    75→
    76→    if similarity < similarity_threshold:
    77→        return False
    78→    if not files_overlap:
    79→        return False
    80→    return True
    81→
    82→
    83→def _merge_finding_details(primary: dict, duplicate: dict) -> None:
    84→    primary_detail = primary.setdefault("detail", {})
    85→    duplicate_detail = duplicate.get("detail", {})
    86→
    87→    merge_list_fields(primary_detail, duplicate_detail, ("related_files", "evidence"))
    88→    pick_longer_text(primary_detail, duplicate_detail, "suggestion")
    89→    track_merged_from(primary_detail, duplicate.get("id", ""))
    90→
    91→
    92→def do_merge(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    93→    """Merge conceptually duplicate open review findings."""
    94→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
    95→    state = runtime.state
    96→    state_file = runtime.state_path
    97→    narrative = compute_narrative(state, context=NarrativeContext(command="review"))
    98→    items = list_open_review_findings(state)
    99→
   100→    if not items:
   101→        print(colorize("\n  No review findings open.\n", "dim"))
   102→        return
   103→
   104→    try:
   105→        similarity = float(getattr(args, "similarity", 0.8))
   106→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   107→        similarity = 0.8
   108→    similarity = max(0.0, min(1.0, similarity))
   109→
   110→    open_holistic = [
   111→        finding
   112→        for finding in items
   113→        if finding.get("detector") == "review"
   114→        and finding.get("detail", {}).get("holistic")
   115→    ]
   116→    if len(open_holistic) < 2:
   117→        print(colorize("\n  Not enough holistic review findings to merge.\n", "dim"))
   118→        return
   119→
   120→    consumed: set[str] = set()
   121→    merge_groups: list[list[dict]] = []
   122→    for candidate in open_holistic:
   123→        candidate_id = candidate.get("id", "")
   124→        if not candidate_id or candidate_id in consumed:
   125→            continue
   126→        group = [candidate]
   127→        consumed.add(candidate_id)
   128→        for other in open_holistic:
   129→            other_id = other.get("id", "")
   130→            if not other_id or other_id in consumed:
   131→                continue
   132→            if _same_issue_concept(
   133→                candidate,
   134→                other,
   135→                similarity_threshold=similarity,
   136→            ):
   137→                consumed.add(other_id)
   138→                group.append(other)
   139→        if len(group) > 1:
   140→            merge_groups.append(group)
   141→
   142→    if not merge_groups:
   143→        print(
   144→            colorize(
   145→                "\n  No duplicate issue concepts found at the current similarity threshold.\n",
   146→                "dim",
   147→            )
   148→        )
   149→        return
   150→
   151→    dry_run = bool(getattr(args, "dry_run", False))
   152→    prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   153→    timestamp = utc_now()
   154→    merged_pairs: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
   155→    for group in merge_groups:
   156→        ranked = sorted(
   157→            group,
   158→            key=lambda finding: (finding_weight(finding)[0], finding.get("id", "")),
   159→            reverse=True,
   160→        )
   161→        primary = ranked[0]
   162→        duplicates = ranked[1:]
   163→        merged_pairs.append((primary.get("id", ""), [d.get("id", "") for d in duplicates]))
   164→        if dry_run:
   165→            continue
   166→        for duplicate in duplicates:
   167→            _merge_finding_details(primary, duplicate)
   168→            duplicate["status"] = "auto_resolved"
   169→            duplicate["resolved_at"] = timestamp
   170→            duplicate["note"] = f"merged into {primary.get('id', '')}"
   171→            duplicate["resolution_attestation"] = {
   172→                "kind": "issue_merge",
   173→                "text": "Merged conceptually duplicate review finding",
   174→                "attested_at": timestamp,
   175→                "scan_verified": False,
   176→            }
   177→        primary_detail = primary.setdefault("detail", {})
   178→        primary_detail["merged_at"] = timestamp
   179→
   180→    print(
   181→        colorize(
   182→            f"\n  Merge groups: {len(merge_groups)} | "
   183→            f"duplicate findings: {sum(len(group) - 1 for group in merge_groups)}",
   184→            "bold",
   185→        )
   186→    )
   187→    for index, (primary_id, duplicate_ids) in enumerate(merged_pairs, 1):
   188→        preview = ", ".join(duplicate_ids[:3])
   189→        if len(duplicate_ids) > 3:
   190→            preview = f"{preview}, +{len(duplicate_ids) - 3} more"
   191→        print(colorize(f"  [{index}] keep {primary_id}", "dim"))
   192→        print(colorize(f"      merge {preview}", "dim"))
   193→
   194→    if dry_run:
   195→        print(colorize("\n  Dry run only: no state changes written.\n", "yellow"))
   196→        return
   197→
   198→    save_state(state, state_file)
   199→    print(colorize("\n  State updated with merged issue groups.", "green"))
   200→    show_score_with_plan_context(state, prev)
   201→    write_query(
   202→        {
   203→            "command": "review",
   204→            "action": "merge",
   205→            "groups": len(merge_groups),
   206→            "duplicates_merged": sum(len(group) - 1 for group in merge_groups),
   207→            "next_command": "desloppify show review --status open",
   208→            "narrative": narrative,
   209→        }
   210→    )

   228→def auto_resolve_review_findings(
   229→    state: dict[str, Any],
   230→    *,
   231→    new_ids: set[str],
   232→    diff: dict[str, Any],
   233→    note: str,
   234→    should_resolve: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], bool],
   235→    utc_now_fn=utc_now,
   236→) -> None:
   237→    """Auto-resolve stale open review findings that match a scope predicate."""
   238→    diff.setdefault("auto_resolved", 0)
   239→    for finding_id, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items():
   240→        if finding_id in new_ids or finding.get("status") != "open":
   241→            continue
   242→        if not should_resolve(finding):

   244→        finding["status"] = "auto_resolved"
   245→        finding["resolved_at"] = utc_now_fn()
   246→        finding["note"] = note

   172→
   173→    kind = str(provenance.get("kind", "")).strip()
   174→    if kind != _BLIND_PROVENANCE_KIND:
   175→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   176→            trusted=False,
   177→            reason=f"unsupported provenance kind: {kind or '<missing>'}",
   178→            import_file=import_file,
   179→        )
   180→
   181→    if provenance.get("blind") is not True:
   182→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   183→            trusted=False,
   184→            reason="provenance is not marked blind=true",
   185→            import_file=import_file,
   186→        )
   187→
   188→    runner = str(provenance.get("runner", "")).strip().lower()
   189→    if runner not in _SUPPORTED_BLIND_REVIEW_RUNNERS:
   190→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   191→            trusted=False,
   192→            reason=f"unsupported runner in provenance: {runner or '<missing>'}",
   193→            import_file=import_file,
   194→        )
   195→
   196→    packet_hash = provenance.get("packet_sha256")
   197→    if not _is_sha256_hex(packet_hash):
   198→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   199→            trusted=False,
   200→            reason="missing or invalid packet_sha256 in provenance",
   201→            import_file=import_file,
   202→        )
   203→
   204→    packet_path = _resolve_packet_path(provenance.get("packet_path"))
   205→    if packet_path is None:
   206→        packet_path = _default_blind_packet_path()
   207→    if not packet_path.exists():
   208→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   209→            trusted=False,
   210→            reason=f"blind packet not found: {packet_path}",
   211→            import_file=import_file,
   212→        )
   213→    observed_hash = _hash_file_sha256(packet_path)
   214→    if observed_hash is None:
   215→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   216→            trusted=False,
   217→            reason=f"unable to hash blind packet: {packet_path}",
   218→            import_file=import_file,
   219→        )
   220→    if observed_hash != packet_hash:
   221→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   222→            trusted=False,
   223→            reason=(
   224→                "blind packet hash mismatch "
   225→                f"(expected {packet_hash[:12]}..., got {observed_hash[:12]}...)"
   226→            ),
   227→            import_file=import_file,
   228→        )
   229→
   230→    return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   231→        trusted=True,
   232→        reason="trusted blind subagent provenance",
   233→        runner=runner,
   234→        packet_path=str(packet_path),
   235→        packet_sha256=packet_hash,
   236→        import_file=import_file,
   237→    )
   238→
   239→
   240→def resolve_override_context(
   241→    *,
   242→    manual_override: bool,
   243→    manual_attest: str | None,
   244→    assessment_override: bool,
   245→    assessment_note: str | None,
   246→) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
   247→    """Support legacy assessment_* flags while preferring manual_* naming."""
   248→    override = bool(manual_override or assessment_override)
   249→    attest = (
   250→        manual_attest
   251→        if isinstance(manual_attest, str) and manual_attest.strip()
   252→        else assessment_note
   253→    )
   254→    if isinstance(attest, str):
   255→        attest = attest.strip()
   256→    return override, attest
   257→
   258→
   259→def _validate_attested_external_attestation(attest: str | None) -> str | None:
   260→    """Validate and normalize attestation text for attested external imports."""
   261→    if not isinstance(attest, str) or not attest.strip():
   262→        return None
   263→    text = attest.strip()
   264→    lowered = text.lower()
   265→    if all(phrase in lowered for phrase in _ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_REQUIRED_PHRASES):
   266→        return text
   267→    return None
   268→
   269→
   270→def _print_import_error_hints(
   271→    errors: list[str],
   272→    *,
   273→    import_file: str,
   274→    colorize_fn,
   275→) -> None:
   276→    """Print actionable retry commands for common import policy failures."""
   277→    joined = " ".join(err.lower() for err in errors)
   278→    quoted_import = shlex.quote(import_file)
   279→    import_cmd = (
   280→        "desloppify review --import "
   281→        f"{quoted_import} --attested-external --attest "
   282→        f"\"{_ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_ATTEST_EXAMPLE}\""
   283→    )
   284→    validate_cmd = (
   285→        "desloppify review --validate-import "
   286→        f"{quoted_import} --attested-external --attest "
   287→        f"\"{_ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_ATTEST_EXAMPLE}\""
   288→    )
   289→    findings_only_cmd = f"desloppify review --import {quoted_import}"
   290→
   291→    if "--attested-external requires --attest containing both" in joined:
   292→        print(
   293→            colorize_fn(
   294→                "  Hint: rerun with the required attestation template:",
   295→                "yellow",
   296→            ),
   297→            file=sys.stderr,
   298→        )
   299→        print(colorize_fn(f"    `{import_cmd}`", "dim"), file=sys.stderr)
   300→        print(
   301→            colorize_fn(
   302→                f"  Preflight without state changes: `{validate_cmd}`",
   303→                "dim",
   304→            ),
   305→            file=sys.stderr,
   306→        )
   307→        return
   308→
   309→    if (
   310→        "--attested-external requires valid blind packet provenance" in joined
   311→        or "supports runner='claude'" in joined
   312→    ):
   313→        print(
   314→            colorize_fn(
   315→                "  Hint: if provenance is valid, rerun with:",
   316→                "yellow",
   317→            ),
   318→            file=sys.stderr,
   319→        )
   320→        print(colorize_fn(f"    `{import_cmd}`", "dim"), file=sys.stderr)
   321→        print(
   322→            colorize_fn(
   323→                f"  Preflight without state changes: `{validate_cmd}`",
   324→                "dim",
   325→            ),
   326→            file=sys.stderr,
   327→        )
   328→        print(
   329→            colorize_fn(
   330→                f"  Findings-only fallback: `{findings_only_cmd}`",
   331→                "dim",
   332→            ),
   333→            file=sys.stderr,
   334→        )
   335→
   336→
   337→def _apply_assessment_import_policy(
   338→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   339→    *,
   340→    import_file: str,
   341→    attested_external: bool,
   342→    attested_attest: str | None,
   343→    manual_override: bool,
   344→    manual_attest: str | None,
   345→    trusted_assessment_source: bool,
   346→    trusted_assessment_label: str | None,
   347→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload | None, list[str]]:
   348→    """Apply trust gating for assessment imports (findings import always allowed)."""
   349→    assessments = findings_data["assessments"]
   350→    has_assessments = bool(assessments)
   351→    assessment_count = len(assessments) if has_assessments else 0
   352→    provenance_status = _assessment_provenance_status(
   353→        findings_data, import_file=import_file
   354→    )
   355→    policy = AssessmentImportPolicyModel(
   356→        assessments_present=has_assessments,
   357→        assessment_count=int(assessment_count),
   358→        trusted=False,
   359→        mode="none",
   360→        reason="",
   361→        provenance=provenance_status,
   362→    )
   363→
   364→    def _attach_policy(payload: ReviewImportPayload) -> ReviewImportPayload:
   365→        normalized = dict(payload)
   366→        normalized[_ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY] = policy.to_dict()
   367→        return normalized
   368→
   369→    if not has_assessments:
   370→        return _attach_policy(findings_data), []
   371→
   372→    if trusted_assessment_source:
   373→        policy = replace(
   374→            policy,
   375→            mode="trusted_internal",
   376→            trusted=True,
   377→            reason=(trusted_assessment_label or "trusted internal run-batches import"),
   378→        )
   379→        return _attach_policy(findings_data), []
   380→
   381→    if attested_external:
   382→        normalized_attest = _validate_attested_external_attestation(attested_attest)
   383→        if normalized_attest is None:
   384→            return None, [
   385→                "--attested-external requires --attest containing both "
   386→                "'without awareness' and 'unbiased'"
   387→            ]
   388→        if provenance_status.trusted is not True:
   389→            return None, [
   390→                "--attested-external requires valid blind packet provenance "
   391→                f"(current status: {provenance_status.reason or 'untrusted provenance'})"
   392→            ]
   393→        runner = provenance_status.runner.strip().lower()
   394→        if runner not in _ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_RUNNERS:
   395→            return None, [
   396→                "--attested-external currently supports runner='claude' provenance only"
   397→            ]
   398→        policy = replace(
   399→            policy,
   400→            mode="attested_external",
   401→            trusted=True,
   402→            reason="attested external blind subagent provenance",
   403→            attest=normalized_attest,
   404→        )
   405→        return _attach_policy(findings_data), []
   406→
   407→    if manual_override:
   408→        if not isinstance(manual_attest, str) or not manual_attest.strip():
   409→            return None, ["--manual-override requires --attest"]
   410→        policy = replace(
   411→            policy,
   412→            mode="manual_override",
   413→            reason="manual override attested by operator",
   414→            attest=manual_attest.strip(),
   415→        )
   416→        return _attach_policy(findings_data), []
   417→
   418→    policy = replace(policy, mode="findings_only")
   419→    if findings_data["provenance"]:
   420→        provenance_reason = provenance_status.reason.strip()
   421→        if provenance_status.trusted is True:
   422→            policy = replace(
   423→                policy,
   424→                reason=(
   425→                    "external imports cannot self-attest trust even when provenance appears valid; "
   426→                    "run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   427→                ),
   428→            )
   429→        elif provenance_reason:
   430→            policy = replace(
   431→                policy,
   432→                reason=(
   433→                    "external imports cannot self-attest trust "
   434→                    f"({provenance_reason}); run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   435→                ),
   436→            )
   437→        else:
   438→            policy = replace(
   439→                policy,
   440→                reason=(
   441→                    "external imports cannot self-attest trust; "
   442→                    "run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   443→                ),
   444→            )
   445→    else:
   446→        policy = replace(
   447→            policy,
   448→            reason="missing trusted run-batches source; imported findings only",
   449→        )
   450→    payload = dict(findings_data)
   451→    payload["assessments"] = {}
   452→    payload[_ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY] = policy.to_dict()
   453→    return payload, []
   454→
   455→
   456→def _has_non_empty_strings(items: object) -> bool:
   457→    """Return True when ``items`` is a list with at least one non-empty string."""
   458→    return isinstance(items, list) and any(
   459→        isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in items
   460→    )
   461→
   462→
   463→def _validate_holistic_findings_schema(
   464→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   465→    *,
   466→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   467→) -> list[str]:
   468→    """Validate strict holistic finding schema expected by issue import."""
   469→    findings = findings_data["findings"]
   470→
   471→    allowed_dimensions: set[str] = set()
   472→    if isinstance(lang_name, str) and lang_name.strip():
   473→        _, dimension_prompts, _ = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang_name)
   474→        allowed_dimensions = set(dimension_prompts)
   475→
   476→    errors: list[str] = []
   477→    for idx, entry in enumerate(findings):
   478→        _normalized: ReviewFindingPayload | None
   479→        _normalized, entry_errors = validate_review_finding_payload(
   480→            entry,
   481→            label=f"findings[{idx}]",
   482→            allowed_dimensions=allowed_dimensions or None,
   483→            allow_dismissed=True,
   484→        )
   485→        for message in entry_errors:
   486→            if (
   487→                "is not allowed" in message
   488→                and lang_name
   489→                and "dimension '" in message
   490→            ):
   491→                message = message.replace(
   492→                    "is not allowed",
   493→                    f"is not valid for language '{lang_name}'",
   494→                )
   495→            errors.append(message)
   496→    return errors
   497→
   498→
   499→def _feedback_dimensions_from_findings(findings: object) -> set[str]:
   500→    """Return dimensions with explicit improvement guidance in findings payload."""
   501→    if not isinstance(findings, list):
   502→        return set()
   503→    dims: set[str] = set()
   504→    for entry in findings:
   505→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   506→            continue
   507→        dim = entry.get("dimension")
   508→        if not isinstance(dim, str) or not dim.strip():
   509→            continue
   510→        suggestion = entry.get("suggestion")
   511→        if isinstance(suggestion, str) and suggestion.strip():
   512→            dims.add(dim.strip())
   513→    return dims
   514→
   515→
   516→def _feedback_dimensions_from_dimension_notes(dimension_notes: object) -> set[str]:
   517→    """Return dimensions with concrete review evidence in dimension_notes payload."""
   518→    if not isinstance(dimension_notes, dict):
   519→        return set()
   520→    dims: set[str] = set()
   521→    for dim, note in dimension_notes.items():
   522→        if not isinstance(dim, str) or not dim.strip():
   523→            continue
   524→        if not isinstance(note, dict):
   525→            continue
   526→        if not _has_non_empty_strings(note.get("evidence")):
   527→            continue
   528→        dims.add(dim.strip())
   529→    return dims
   530→
   531→
   532→def _validate_assessment_feedback(
   533→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   534→) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
   535→    """Return dimensions missing required feedback and required low-score findings."""
   536→    assessments = findings_data["assessments"]
   537→    if not assessments:
   538→        return [], []
   539→
   540→    finding_dims = _feedback_dimensions_from_findings(findings_data["findings"])
   541→    feedback_dims = set(finding_dims)
   542→    feedback_dims.update(
   543→        _feedback_dimensions_from_dimension_notes(findings_data["dimension_notes"])
   544→    )
   545→    missing_feedback: list[str] = []
   546→    missing_low_score_findings: list[str] = []
   547→    for dim_name, payload in assessments.items():
   548→        if not isinstance(dim_name, str) or not dim_name.strip():
   549→            continue
   550→        score = coerce_assessment_score(payload)
   551→        if score is None:
   552→            continue
   553→        if score_requires_dimension_finding(score) and dim_name not in finding_dims:
   554→            missing_low_score_findings.append(f"{dim_name} ({score:.1f})")
   555→        if score_requires_explicit_feedback(score) and dim_name not in feedback_dims:
   556→            missing_feedback.append(f"{dim_name} ({score:.1f})")
   557→    return sorted(missing_feedback), sorted(missing_low_score_findings)
   558→
   559→
   560→def _parse_and_validate_import(
   561→    import_file: str,
   562→    *,
   563→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   564→    allow_partial: bool = False,
   565→    trusted_assessment_source: bool = False,
   566→    trusted_assessment_label: str | None = None,
   567→    attested_external: bool = False,
   568→    manual_override: bool = False,
   569→    manual_attest: str | None = None,
   570→    assessment_override: bool = False,
   571→    assessment_note: str | None = None,
   572→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload | None, list[str]]:
   573→    """Parse and validate a review import file (pure function).
   574→
   575→    Returns ``(data, errors)`` where *data* is the normalized payload on
   576→    success, or ``None`` when errors prevent import.
   577→    """
   578→    findings_path = Path(import_file)
   579→    if not findings_path.exists():
   580→        return None, [f"file not found: {import_file}"]
   581→    try:
   582→        findings_data = json.loads(findings_path.read_text())
   583→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as exc:
   584→        return None, [f"error reading findings: {exc}"]
   585→
   586→    if isinstance(findings_data, list):
   587→        findings_data = {"findings": findings_data}
   588→
   589→    if not isinstance(findings_data, dict):
   590→        return None, ["findings file must contain a JSON array or object"]
   591→
   592→    if "findings" not in findings_data:
   593→        return None, ["findings object must contain a 'findings' key"]
   594→    normalized_findings_data, shape_errors = _normalize_import_payload_shape(
   595→        findings_data
   596→    )
   597→    if shape_errors:
   598→        return None, shape_errors
   599→    assert normalized_findings_data is not None
   600→
   601→    override_enabled, override_attest = resolve_override_context(
   602→        manual_override=manual_override,
   603→        manual_attest=manual_attest,
   604→        assessment_override=assessment_override,
   605→        assessment_note=assessment_note,
   606→    )
   607→    if attested_external and override_enabled:
   608→        return None, [
   609→            "--attested-external cannot be combined with --manual-override"
   610→        ]
   611→    if attested_external and allow_partial:
   612→        return None, [
   613→            "--attested-external cannot be combined with --allow-partial; "
   614→            "attested score imports require fully valid findings payloads"
   615→        ]
   616→    if override_enabled and allow_partial:
   617→        return None, [
   618→            "--manual-override cannot be combined with --allow-partial; "
   619→            "manual score imports require fully valid findings payloads"
   620→        ]
   621→    findings_data, policy_errors = _apply_assessment_import_policy(
   622→        normalized_findings_data,
   623→        import_file=import_file,
   624→        attested_external=attested_external,
   625→        attested_attest=override_attest,
   626→        manual_override=override_enabled,
   627→        manual_attest=override_attest,
   628→        trusted_assessment_source=trusted_assessment_source,
   629→        trusted_assessment_label=trusted_assessment_label,
   630→    )
   631→    if policy_errors:
   632→        return None, policy_errors
   633→    assert findings_data is not None
   634→
   635→    missing_feedback, missing_low_score_findings = _validate_assessment_feedback(
   636→        findings_data
   637→    )
   638→    if missing_low_score_findings:
   639→        if override_enabled:
   640→            if not isinstance(override_attest, str) or not override_attest.strip():
   641→                return None, ["--manual-override requires --attest"]
   642→            return findings_data, []
   643→        return None, [
   644→            f"assessments below {LOW_SCORE_FINDING_THRESHOLD:.1f} must include at "
   645→            "least one finding for that same dimension with a concrete suggestion. "
   646→            f"Missing: {', '.join(missing_low_score_findings)}"
   647→        ]
   648→
   649→    if missing_feedback:
   650→        if override_enabled:
   651→            if not isinstance(override_attest, str) or not override_attest.strip():
   652→                return None, ["--manual-override requires --attest"]
   653→            return findings_data, []
   654→        return None, [
   655→            f"assessments below {ASSESSMENT_FEEDBACK_THRESHOLD:.1f} must include explicit feedback "
   656→            "(finding with same dimension and non-empty suggestion, or "
   657→            "dimension_notes evidence for that dimension). "
   658→            f"Missing: {', '.join(missing_feedback)}"
   659→        ]
   660→
   661→    schema_errors = _validate_holistic_findings_schema(
   662→        findings_data,
   663→        lang_name=lang_name,
   664→    )
   665→    if schema_errors and not allow_partial:
   666→        visible_errors = schema_errors[:10]
   667→        remaining = len(schema_errors) - len(visible_errors)
   668→        errors = [
   669→            "findings schema validation failed for holistic import. "
   670→            "Fix payload or rerun with --allow-partial to continue."
   671→        ]
   672→        errors.extend(visible_errors)
   673→        if remaining > 0:
   674→            errors.append(f"... {remaining} additional schema error(s) omitted")
   675→        return None, errors
   676→
   677→    return findings_data, []
   678→
   679→
   680→def load_import_findings_data(
   681→    import_file: str,
   682→    *,
   683→    colorize_fn=None,
   684→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   685→    allow_partial: bool = False,
   686→    trusted_assessment_source: bool = False,
   687→    trusted_assessment_label: str | None = None,
   688→    attested_external: bool = False,
   689→    manual_override: bool = False,
   690→    manual_attest: str | None = None,
   691→    assessment_override: bool = False,
   692→    assessment_note: str | None = None,
   693→) -> ReviewImportPayload:
   694→    """Load and normalize review import payload to object format.
   695→
   696→    Raises ``ImportPayloadLoadError`` when validation fails.
   697→    """
   698→    data, errors = _parse_and_validate_import(
   699→        import_file,
   700→        lang_name=lang_name,
   701→        allow_partial=allow_partial,
   702→        trusted_assessment_source=trusted_assessment_source,
   703→        trusted_assessment_label=trusted_assessment_label,
   704→        attested_external=attested_external,
   705→        manual_override=manual_override,
   706→        manual_attest=manual_attest,
   707→        assessment_override=assessment_override,
   708→        assessment_note=assessment_note,
   709→    )
   710→    if errors:
   711→        raise ImportPayloadLoadError(errors)
   712→    assert data is not None  # guaranteed when errors is empty
   713→    return data
   714→
   715→
   716→def print_import_load_errors(
   717→    errors: list[str],
   718→    *,
   719→    import_file: str,
   720→    colorize_fn,
   721→) -> None:
   722→    """Print import payload validation errors and actionable hints."""
   723→    for err in errors:
   724→        print(colorize_fn(f"  Error: {err}", "red"), file=sys.stderr)
   725→    _print_import_error_hints(errors, import_file=import_file, colorize_fn=colorize_fn)
   726→
   727→
   728→def assessment_policy_from_payload(payload: ReviewImportPayload) -> AssessmentImportPolicy:
   729→    """Return parsed assessment policy metadata from a loaded import payload."""
   730→    policy = payload[_ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY]
   731→    if isinstance(policy, dict):
   732→        return policy
   733→    return AssessmentImportPolicyModel().to_dict()
   734→
   735→
   736→def assessment_policy_model_from_payload(
   737→    payload: ReviewImportPayload,
   738→) -> AssessmentImportPolicyModel:
   739→    """Return typed assessment policy metadata from a loaded import payload."""
   740→    return AssessmentImportPolicyModel.from_mapping(assessment_policy_from_payload(payload))
   741→
   742→
   743→def assessment_mode_label(policy: AssessmentImportPolicy) -> str:
   744→    """Return a user-facing label for the selected assessment import mode."""
   745→    mode = AssessmentImportPolicyModel.from_mapping(policy).mode.strip().lower()
   746→    return _ASSESSMENT_MODE_LABELS.get(mode, f"unknown ({mode or 'none'})")
   747→
   748→
   749→def print_assessment_mode_banner(
   750→    policy: AssessmentImportPolicy,
   751→    *,
   752→    colorize_fn,
   753→) -> None:
   754→    """Print the selected assessment import mode to make policy explicit."""
   755→    policy_model = AssessmentImportPolicyModel.from_mapping(policy)

   878→        validation_errors = [r for r in reasons if r.startswith("invalid ")]
   879→        parts = []

    33→
    34→# Mechanical detectors → subjective dimensions they provide evidence for.
    35→# When findings from these detectors change during a scan, the corresponding
    36→# subjective assessments are marked stale so reviewers know to re-evaluate.
    37→_DETECTOR_SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSIONS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    38→    "structural": ("design_coherence", "abstraction_fitness"),
    39→    "smells": ("design_coherence", "error_consistency"),
    40→    "global_mutable_config": ("initialization_coupling",),
    41→    "coupling": ("cross_module_architecture",),
    42→    "layer_violation": ("cross_module_architecture",),
    43→    "private_imports": ("cross_module_architecture",),
    44→    "dupes": ("convention_outlier",),
    45→    "boilerplate_duplication": ("convention_outlier",),
    46→    "naming": ("convention_outlier",),
    47→    "flat_dirs": ("package_organization",),
    48→    "orphaned": ("design_coherence",),
    49→    "uncalled_functions": ("design_coherence",),
    50→    "responsibility_cohesion": ("design_coherence", "abstraction_fitness"),
    51→    "cycles": ("cross_module_architecture", "dependency_health"),
    52→}
    53→
    54→
    55→def _mark_stale_on_mechanical_change(
    56→    state: StateModel,
    57→    *,
    58→    changed_detectors: set[str],
    59→    now: str,
    60→) -> None:
    61→    """Mark subjective assessments stale when mechanical findings change.
    62→
    63→    Only marks dimensions that already have an assessment — doesn't create
    64→    new entries for dimensions that have never been reviewed.
    65→    """
    66→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    67→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    68→        return
    69→
    70→    affected_dims: set[str] = set()
    71→    for detector in changed_detectors:
    72→        dims = _DETECTOR_SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSIONS.get(detector, ())
    73→        affected_dims.update(dims)
    74→
    75→    if not affected_dims:
    76→        return
    77→
    78→    for dimension in sorted(affected_dims):
    79→        if dimension not in assessments:
    80→            continue
    81→        payload = assessments[dimension]
    82→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    83→            continue
    84→        # Don't overwrite if already stale
    85→        if payload.get("needs_review_refresh"):
    86→            continue
    87→        payload["needs_review_refresh"] = True
    88→        payload["refresh_reason"] = "mechanical_findings_changed"
    89→        payload["stale_since"] = now
    90→
    91→
    92→@dataclass
    93→class MergeScanOptions:
    94→    """Configuration bundle for merging a scan into persisted state."""
    95→
    96→    lang: str | None = None
    97→    scan_path: str | None = None
    98→    force_resolve: bool = False
    99→    exclude: tuple[str, ...] = ()
   100→    potentials: dict[str, int] | None = None
   101→    merge_potentials: bool = False
   102→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   103→    include_slow: bool = True
   104→    ignore: list[str] | None = None
   105→    subjective_integrity_target: float | None = None
   106→
   107→
   108→def merge_scan(
   109→    state: StateModel,
   110→    current_findings: list[dict],
   111→    options: MergeScanOptions | None = None,
   112→) -> ScanDiff:
   113→    """Merge a fresh scan into existing state and return a diff summary."""
   114→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   115→    resolved_options = options or MergeScanOptions()
   116→
   117→    now = utc_now()
   118→    _record_scan_metadata(
   119→        state,
   120→        now,
   121→        lang=resolved_options.lang,
   122→        include_slow=resolved_options.include_slow,
   123→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   124→    )
   125→    _merge_scan_inputs(
   126→        state,
   127→        lang=resolved_options.lang,
   128→        potentials=resolved_options.potentials,
   129→        merge_potentials=resolved_options.merge_potentials,
   130→        codebase_metrics=resolved_options.codebase_metrics,
   131→    )
   132→
   133→    existing = state["findings"]
   134→    ignore_patterns = (
   135→        resolved_options.ignore
   136→        if resolved_options.ignore is not None
   137→        else state.get("config", {}).get("ignore", [])
   138→    )
   139→    current_ids, new_count, reopened_count, current_by_detector, ignored_count, upsert_changed = (
   140→        upsert_findings(
   141→            existing,
   142→            current_findings,
   143→            ignore_patterns,
   144→            now,
   145→            lang=resolved_options.lang,
   146→        )
   147→    )
   148→
   149→    raw_findings = len(current_findings)
   150→    suppressed_pct = _compute_suppression(raw_findings, ignored_count)
   151→
   152→    ran_detectors = (
   153→        set(resolved_options.potentials.keys())
   154→        if resolved_options.potentials is not None
   155→        else None
   156→    )
   157→    suspect_detectors = find_suspect_detectors(
   158→        existing,
   159→        current_by_detector,
   160→        resolved_options.force_resolve,
   161→        ran_detectors,
   162→    )
   163→    auto_resolved, skipped_other_lang, skipped_out_of_scope, resolve_changed = auto_resolve_disappeared(
   164→        existing,
   165→        current_ids,
   166→        suspect_detectors,
   167→        now,
   168→        lang=resolved_options.lang,
   169→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   170→        exclude=resolved_options.exclude,
   171→    )
   172→
   173→    # Mark subjective assessments stale when mechanical findings changed.
   174→    changed_detectors = upsert_changed | resolve_changed
   175→    if changed_detectors:
   176→        _mark_stale_on_mechanical_change(
   177→            state, changed_detectors=changed_detectors, now=now,
   178→        )
   179→
   180→    _recompute_stats(
   181→        state,
   182→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   183→        subjective_integrity_target=resolved_options.subjective_integrity_target,
   184→    )
   185→    _append_scan_history(
   186→        state,
   187→        now=now,
   188→        lang=resolved_options.lang,
   189→        new_count=new_count,
   190→        auto_resolved=auto_resolved,
   191→        ignored_count=ignored_count,
   192→        raw_findings=raw_findings,
   193→        suppressed_pct=suppressed_pct,
   194→        ignore_pattern_count=len(ignore_patterns),
   195→    )
   196→
   197→    chronic_reopeners = [
   198→        finding
   199→        for finding in existing.values()
   200→        if finding.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2 and finding["status"] == "open"
   201→    ]
   202→
   203→    validate_state_invariants(state)
   204→    return _build_merge_diff(
   205→        new_count=new_count,
   206→        auto_resolved=auto_resolved,
   207→        reopened_count=reopened_count,
   208→        current_ids=current_ids,
   209→        suspect_detectors=suspect_detectors,
   210→        chronic_reopeners=chronic_reopeners,
   211→        skipped_other_lang=skipped_other_lang,
   212→        skipped_out_of_scope=skipped_out_of_scope,
   213→        ignored_count=ignored_count,
   214→        ignore_pattern_count=len(ignore_patterns),
   215→        raw_findings=raw_findings,
   216→        suppressed_pct=suppressed_pct,
   217→    )

   362→def _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   363→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   364→    *,
   365→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   366→) -> int:
   367→    """Reset known subjective dimensions to 0 so the next scan starts fresh."""
   368→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   369→
   370→    reset_keys = {
   371→        key.strip()
   372→        for key in assessments
   373→        if isinstance(key, str) and key.strip()
   374→    }
   375→    reset_keys.update(_subjective_reset_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name))
   376→
   377→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   378→    for key in sorted(reset_keys):
   379→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   380→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   381→            payload["score"] = 0.0
   382→            payload["source"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   383→            payload["assessed_at"] = now
   384→            payload["reset_by"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   385→            payload["placeholder"] = True
   386→            payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   387→            payload.pop("components", None)
   388→            payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   389→            continue
   390→        assessments[key] = {
   391→            "score": 0.0,
   392→            "source": "scan_reset_subjective",
   393→            "assessed_at": now,
   394→            "reset_by": "scan_reset_subjective",
   395→            "placeholder": True,
   396→        }
   397→    return len(reset_keys)

   400→def _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   401→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   402→) -> int:
   403→    """Expire provisional manual-override assessments at scan start."""
   404→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   405→
   406→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   407→    expired = 0
   408→    for payload in assessments.values():
   409→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   410→            continue
   411→        if payload.get("provisional_override") is not True:
   412→            continue
   413→        payload["score"] = 0.0
   414→        payload["source"] = "manual_override_expired"
   415→        payload["assessed_at"] = now
   416→        payload["reset_by"] = "manual_override_expired"
   417→        payload["placeholder"] = True
   418→        payload.pop("provisional_override", None)
   419→        payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)
   420→        payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   421→        payload.pop("components", None)
   422→        payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   423→        expired += 1
   424→    return expired

   427→def prepare_scan_runtime(args) -> ScanRuntime:
   428→    """Resolve state/config/language and apply scan-time runtime settings."""
   429→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   430→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   431→    state = runtime.state if isinstance(runtime.state, dict) else {}
   432→    state_mod.ensure_state_defaults(state)
   433→    path = Path(args.path)
   434→    config = runtime.config if isinstance(runtime.config, dict) else {}
   435→    lang_config = resolve_lang(args)
   436→    reset_subjective_count = 0
   437→    expired_manual_override_count = _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   438→        state
   439→    )
   440→    if getattr(args, "reset_subjective", False):
   441→        reset_subjective_count = _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   442→            state,
   443→            lang_name=getattr(lang_config, "name", None),
   444→        )
   445→
   446→    include_slow = not getattr(args, "skip_slow", False)
   447→    profile = _resolve_scan_profile(getattr(args, "profile", None), lang_config)
   448→    effective_include_slow = _effective_include_slow(include_slow, profile)
   449→
   450→    lang = _configure_lang_runtime(args, config, state, lang_config)
   451→    coverage_warnings = _seed_runtime_coverage_warnings(lang)
   452→    zone_overrides_raw = config.get("zone_overrides")
   453→    zone_overrides = zone_overrides_raw if isinstance(zone_overrides_raw, dict) else None
   454→
   455→    return ScanRuntime(
   456→        args=args,
   457→        state_path=state_file,
   458→        state=state,
   459→        path=path,
   460→        config=config,
   461→        lang=lang,
   462→        lang_label=f" ({lang.name})" if lang else "",
   463→        profile=profile,
   464→        effective_include_slow=effective_include_slow,
   465→        zone_overrides=zone_overrides,
   466→        reset_subjective_count=reset_subjective_count,
   467→        expired_manual_override_count=expired_manual_override_count,
   468→        coverage_warnings=coverage_warnings,
   469→    )

   472→def _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(
   473→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   474→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   475→) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   476→    """Append stale exclude findings when excluded dirs are unreferenced."""
   477→    extra_exclusions = get_exclusions()
   478→    if not (extra_exclusions and runtime.lang and runtime.lang.file_finder):
   479→        return findings
   480→
   481→    scanned_files = runtime.lang.file_finder(runtime.path)
   482→    stale = _audit_excluded_dirs(
   483→        extra_exclusions, scanned_files, PROJECT_ROOT
   484→    )
   485→    if not stale:
   486→        return findings
   487→
   488→    augmented = list(findings)
   489→    augmented.extend(stale)
   490→    for stale_finding in stale:
   491→        print(colorize(f"  ℹ {stale_finding['summary']}", "dim"))
   492→    return augmented
   493→
   494→
   495→def _augment_with_stale_wontfix_findings(
   496→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   497→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   498→    *,
   499→    decay_scans: int,
   500→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:
   501→    """Append re-triage findings for stale/worsening wontfix debt."""
   502→    return _augment_stale_wontfix_impl(
   503→        findings,
   504→        state=runtime.state,
   505→        scan_path=runtime.path,
   506→        project_root=PROJECT_ROOT,
   507→        decay_scans=decay_scans,
   508→    )
   509→
   510→
   511→def run_scan_generation(
   512→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   513→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, object], dict[str, object] | None]:
   514→    """Run detector pipeline and return findings, potentials, and codebase metrics."""
   515→    enable_file_cache()
   516→    enable_parse_cache()
   517→    try:
   518→        findings, potentials = plan_mod.generate_findings(
   519→            runtime.path,
   520→            lang=runtime.lang,
   521→            options=PlanScanOptions(
   522→                include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   523→                zone_overrides=runtime.zone_overrides,
   524→                profile=runtime.profile,
   525→            ),
   526→        )
   527→    finally:
   528→        disable_parse_cache()
   529→        disable_file_cache()
   530→
   531→    codebase_metrics = _collect_codebase_metrics(runtime.lang, runtime.path)
   532→    _warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   533→        runtime.args, runtime.lang, runtime.path, codebase_metrics
   534→    )
   535→    findings = _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(findings, runtime)
   536→    decay_scans = _coerce_int(
   537→        runtime.config.get("wontfix_decay_scans"),
   538→        default=_WONTFIX_DECAY_SCANS_DEFAULT,
   539→    )
   540→    findings, monitored_wontfix = _augment_with_stale_wontfix_findings(
   541→        findings,
   542→        runtime,
   543→        decay_scans=max(decay_scans, 0),
   544→    )
   545→    potentials["stale_wontfix"] = monitored_wontfix
   546→    return findings, potentials, codebase_metrics
   547→
   548→
   549→def merge_scan_results(
   550→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   551→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   552→    potentials: dict[str, object],
   553→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, object] | None,
   554→) -> ScanMergeResult:
   555→    """Merge findings into persistent state and return diff + previous score snapshot."""
   556→    scan_path_rel = rel(str(runtime.path))
   557→    prev_scan_path = runtime.state.get("scan_path")
   558→    path_changed = prev_scan_path is not None and prev_scan_path != scan_path_rel
   559→
   560→    if not path_changed:
   561→        prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(runtime.state)
   562→    else:
   563→        prev = state_mod.ScoreSnapshot(None, None, None, None)
   564→    prev_dim_scores = (
   565→        runtime.state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if not path_changed else {}
   566→    )
   567→
   568→    if runtime.lang and runtime.lang.zone_map is not None:
   569→        runtime.state["zone_distribution"] = runtime.lang.zone_map.counts()
   570→    _persist_scan_coverage(runtime.state, runtime.lang)
   571→
   572→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   573→
   574→    diff = state_mod.merge_scan(
   575→        runtime.state,
   576→        findings,
   577→        options=state_mod.MergeScanOptions(
   578→            lang=runtime.lang.name if runtime.lang else None,
   579→            scan_path=scan_path_rel,
   580→            force_resolve=getattr(runtime.args, "force_resolve", False),
   581→            exclude=get_exclusions(),
   582→            potentials=potentials,
   583→            codebase_metrics=codebase_metrics,
   584→            include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   585→            ignore=runtime.config.get("ignore", []),
   586→            subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   587→        ),
   588→    )
   589→
   590→    issues_mod.expire_stale_holistic(
   591→        runtime.state, runtime.config.get("holistic_max_age_days", 30)
   592→    )
   593→    state_mod.save_state(
   594→        runtime.state,
   595→        runtime.state_path,
   596→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   597→    )
   598→
   599→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   600→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   601→
   602→    return ScanMergeResult(
   603→        diff=diff,
   604→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   605→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   606→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   607→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   608→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   609→    )
   610→
   611→
   612→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   613→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   614→    config: dict[str, object],
   615→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   616→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden finding counters."""
   617→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   618→        state_mod.resolve_finding_noise_settings(config)
   619→    )
   620→    findings_by_id = _state_findings(state)
   621→    open_findings = [
   622→        finding
   623→        for finding in state_mod.path_scoped_findings(
   624→            findings_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   625→        ).values()
   626→        if finding.get("status") == "open"
   627→    ]
   628→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(
   629→        open_findings,
   630→        budget=noise_budget,
   631→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   632→    )
   633→
   634→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   635→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   636→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   637→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   638→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   639→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   640→    )
   641→
   642→
   643→def persist_reminder_history(
   644→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   645→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   646→) -> None:
   647→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   648→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   649→        return
   650→
   651→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   652→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   653→    state_mod.save_state(
   654→        runtime.state,
   655→        runtime.state_path,
   656→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   657→    )
   658→
   659→
   660→__all__ = [
   661→    "ScanStateContractError",
   662→    "ScanMergeResult",
   663→    "ScanNoiseSnapshot",
   664→    "ScanRuntime",
   665→    "merge_scan_results",
   666→    "persist_reminder_history",
   667→    "prepare_scan_runtime",
   668→    "resolve_noise_snapshot",
   669→    "run_scan_generation",
   670→]

1→"""Finding upsert/auto-resolve helpers for scan merge."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import matched_ignore_pattern
     6→from desloppify.core.discovery_api import matches_exclusion
     7→
     8→
     9→def find_suspect_detectors(
    10→    existing: dict,
    11→    current_by_detector: dict[str, int],
    12→    force_resolve: bool,
    13→    ran_detectors: set[str] | None = None,
    14→) -> set[str]:
    15→    """Detectors that had open findings but likely did not actually run this scan."""
    16→    if force_resolve:
    17→        return set()
    18→
    19→    previous_open_by_detector: dict[str, int] = {}
    20→    for finding in existing.values():
    21→        if finding["status"] != "open":
    22→            continue
    23→        detector = finding.get("detector", "unknown")
    24→        previous_open_by_detector[detector] = (
    25→            previous_open_by_detector.get(detector, 0) + 1
    26→        )
    27→
    28→    # 'review' findings enter via `desloppify review --import`, not via scan phases.
    29→    # They are always marked suspect so the scan never auto-resolves them.
    30→    import_only_detectors = {"review"}
    31→    suspect: set[str] = set()
    32→
    33→    for detector, previous_count in previous_open_by_detector.items():
    34→        if detector in import_only_detectors:
    35→            suspect.add(detector)
    36→            continue
    37→        if current_by_detector.get(detector, 0) > 0:
    38→            continue
    39→        if ran_detectors is not None:
    40→            if detector not in ran_detectors:
    41→                suspect.add(detector)
    42→            continue
    43→        if previous_count >= 3:
    44→            suspect.add(detector)
    45→
    46→    return suspect
    47→
    48→
    49→def auto_resolve_disappeared(
    50→    existing: dict,
    51→    current_ids: set[str],
    52→    suspect_detectors: set[str],
    53→    now: str,
    54→    *,
    55→    lang: str | None,
    56→    scan_path: str | None,
    57→    exclude: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    58→) -> tuple[int, int, int, set[str]]:
    59→    """Auto-resolve open/wontfix/fixed/false_positive findings absent from scan.
    60→
    61→    Returns (resolved, skipped_other_lang, skipped_out_of_scope, resolved_detectors).
    62→    """
    63→    resolved = skipped_other_lang = skipped_out_of_scope = 0
    64→    resolved_detectors: set[str] = set()
    65→
    66→    for finding_id, previous in existing.items():
    67→        if finding_id in current_ids or previous["status"] not in (
    68→            "open",
    69→            "wontfix",
    70→            "fixed",
    71→            "false_positive",
    72→        ):
    73→            continue
    74→
    75→        if lang and previous.get("lang") and previous["lang"] != lang:
    76→            skipped_other_lang += 1
    77→            continue
    78→
    79→        if scan_path and scan_path != ".":
    80→            prefix = scan_path.rstrip("/") + "/"
    81→            if (
    82→                not previous["file"].startswith(prefix)
    83→                and previous["file"] != scan_path
    84→            ):
    85→                skipped_out_of_scope += 1
    86→                continue
    87→
    88→        if exclude and any(matches_exclusion(previous["file"], ex) for ex in exclude):
    89→            continue
    90→
    91→        if previous.get("detector", "unknown") in suspect_detectors:
    92→            continue
    93→
    94→        previous_status = previous["status"]
    95→        previous["status"] = "auto_resolved"
    96→        previous["resolved_at"] = now
    97→        previous["suppressed"] = False
    98→        previous["suppressed_at"] = None
    99→        previous["suppression_pattern"] = None
   100→        previous["resolution_attestation"] = {
   101→            "kind": "scan_verified",
   102→            "text": "Disappeared from detector output",
   103→            "attested_at": now,
   104→            "scan_verified": True,
   105→        }
   106→        previous["note"] = (
   107→            "Fixed despite wontfix — disappeared from scan (was wontfix)"
   108→            if previous_status == "wontfix"
   109→            else "Disappeared from scan — likely fixed"
   110→        )
   111→        resolved_detectors.add(previous.get("detector", "unknown"))
   112→        resolved += 1
   113→
   114→    return resolved, skipped_other_lang, skipped_out_of_scope, resolved_detectors
   115→
   116→
   117→def upsert_findings(
   118→    existing: dict,
   119→    current_findings: list[dict],
   120→    ignore: list[str],
   121→    now: str,
   122→    *,
   123→    lang: str | None,
   124→) -> tuple[set[str], int, int, dict[str, int], int, set[str]]:
   125→    """Insert new findings and update existing ones.
   126→
   127→    Returns (current_ids, new_count, reopened_count, by_detector, ignored_count, changed_detectors).
   128→    """
   129→    current_ids: set[str] = set()
   130→    new_count = reopened_count = ignored_count = 0
   131→    by_detector: dict[str, int] = {}
   132→    changed_detectors: set[str] = set()
   133→
   134→    for finding in current_findings:
   135→        finding_id = finding["id"]
   136→        detector = finding.get("detector", "unknown")
   137→        current_ids.add(finding_id)
   138→        by_detector[detector] = by_detector.get(detector, 0) + 1
   139→        matched_ignore = matched_ignore_pattern(finding_id, finding["file"], ignore)
   140→        if matched_ignore:
   141→            ignored_count += 1
   142→
   143→        if lang:
   144→            finding["lang"] = lang
   145→
   146→        if finding_id not in existing:
   147→            existing[finding_id] = dict(finding)
   148→            if matched_ignore:
   149→                existing[finding_id]["suppressed"] = True
   150→                existing[finding_id]["suppressed_at"] = now
   151→                existing[finding_id]["suppression_pattern"] = matched_ignore
   152→                continue
   153→            new_count += 1
   154→            changed_detectors.add(detector)
   155→            continue
   156→
   157→        previous = existing[finding_id]
   158→        previous.update(
   159→            last_seen=now,
   160→            tier=finding["tier"],
   161→            confidence=finding["confidence"],
   162→            summary=finding["summary"],
   163→            detail=finding.get("detail", {}),
   164→        )
   165→        if "zone" in finding:
   166→            previous["zone"] = finding["zone"]
   167→        if lang and not previous.get("lang"):
   168→            previous["lang"] = lang
   169→
   170→        if matched_ignore:
   171→            previous["suppressed"] = True
   172→            previous["suppressed_at"] = now
   173→            previous["suppression_pattern"] = matched_ignore
   174→            continue
   175→
   176→        previous["suppressed"] = False
   177→        previous["suppressed_at"] = None
   178→        previous["suppression_pattern"] = None
   179→
   180→        if previous["status"] in ("fixed", "auto_resolved"):
   181→            # subjective_review findings are condition-based.  When just
   182→            # auto-resolved by an agent import, skip reopening to avoid a
   183→            # resolve-then-reopen loop on the same scan cycle.
   184→            if (
   185→                detector == "subjective_review"
   186→                and previous["status"] == "auto_resolved"
   187→                and (previous.get("resolution_attestation") or {}).get("kind") == "agent_import"
   188→            ):
   189→                continue
   190→            previous_status = previous["status"]
   191→            previous["reopen_count"] = previous.get("reopen_count", 0) + 1
   192→            previous.pop("resolution_attestation", None)
   193→            previous.update(
   194→                status="open",
   195→                resolved_at=None,
   196→                note=(
   197→                    f"Reopened (×{previous['reopen_count']}) "
   198→                    f"— reappeared in scan (was {previous_status})"
   199→                ),
   200→            )
   201→            reopened_count += 1
   202→            changed_detectors.add(detector)
   203→
   204→    return current_ids, new_count, reopened_count, by_detector, ignored_count, changed_detectors
   205→
   206→
   207→__all__ = [
   208→    "auto_resolve_disappeared",
   209→    "find_suspect_detectors",
   210→    "upsert_findings",
   211→]

    46→def _short_id(fid: str) -> str:
    47→    """Extract the 8-char hash suffix from a finding ID for compact display.
    48→
    49→    Finding IDs look like ``review::.::holistic::dim::identifier::abcdef12``.
    50→    Commands accept the hash suffix as a shorthand for the full ID.
    51→    """
    52→    if "::" in fid:
    53→        suffix = fid.rsplit("::", 1)[-1]
    54→        if len(suffix) >= 8:
    55→            return suffix[:8]
    56→    return fid
    57→
    58→
    59→def _synthesis_coverage(plan: dict) -> tuple[int, int, dict]:
    60→    """Return (organized, total, clusters) for synthesis progress."""
    61→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    62→    all_cluster_ids: set[str] = set()
    63→    for c in clusters.values():
    64→        all_cluster_ids.update(c.get("finding_ids", []))
    65→    queue_ids = [fid for fid in plan.get("queue_order", []) if fid != SYNTHESIS_ID]
    66→    organized = sum(1 for fid in queue_ids if fid in all_cluster_ids)
    67→    return organized, len(queue_ids), clusters
    68→
    69→
    70→def _unenriched_clusters(plan: dict) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
    71→    """Return clusters with findings that are missing required enrichment.
    72→
    73→    Returns list of (cluster_name, list_of_missing_fields).
    74→    Only checks non-auto clusters (manual clusters the agent creates).
    75→    """
    76→    gaps: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
    77→    for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items():
    78→        if not cluster.get("finding_ids"):
    79→            continue
    80→        if cluster.get("auto"):
    81→            continue
    82→        missing: list[str] = []
    83→        if not cluster.get("description"):
    84→            missing.append("description")
    85→        if not cluster.get("action_steps"):
    86→            missing.append("action_steps")
    87→        if missing:
    88→            gaps.append((name, missing))
    89→    return gaps
    90→
    91→
    92→def _manual_clusters_with_findings(plan: dict) -> list[str]:
    93→    """Return names of non-auto clusters that have findings."""
    94→    return [
    95→        name for name, c in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
    96→        if c.get("finding_ids") and not c.get("auto")
    97→    ]

   100→def _print_stage_progress(stages: dict, plan: dict | None = None) -> None:
   101→    """Print the 4-stage progress indicator."""
   102→    print(colorize("  Stages:", "dim"))
   103→    for stage_name, label in SYNTHESIS_STAGE_LABELS:
   104→        if stage_name in stages:
   105→            print(colorize(f"    \u2713 {label}", "green"))
   106→        elif SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES[stage_name].issubset(stages):
   107→            print(colorize(f"    \u2192 {label} (current)", "yellow"))
   108→        else:
   109→            print(colorize(f"    \u25cb {label}", "dim"))
   110→
   111→    # Show enrichment gaps when in the organize stage
   112→    if plan and "reflect" in stages and "organize" not in stages:
   113→        gaps = _unenriched_clusters(plan)
   114→        manual = _manual_clusters_with_findings(plan)
   115→        if not manual:
   116→            print(colorize("\n    No manual clusters yet. Create clusters and enrich them.", "yellow"))
   117→        elif gaps:
   118→            print(colorize(f"\n    {len(gaps)} cluster(s) need enrichment:", "yellow"))
   119→            for name, missing in gaps:
   120→                print(colorize(f"      {name}: missing {', '.join(missing)}", "yellow"))
   121→            print(colorize(

   123→                "dim",
   124→            ))
   125→        else:
   126→            print(colorize(f"\n    All {len(manual)} manual cluster(s) enriched.", "green"))
   127→
   128→
   129→def _print_progress(plan: dict, open_findings: dict) -> None:
   130→    """Show cluster state and unclustered findings."""
   131→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   132→    # Only show clusters that actually have findings (hide empty/stale ones)
   133→    active_clusters = {
   134→        name: c for name, c in clusters.items()
   135→        if c.get("finding_ids")
   136→    }
   137→    if active_clusters:
   138→        print(colorize("\n  Current clusters:", "cyan"))
   139→        for name, cluster in active_clusters.items():
   140→            count = len(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   141→            desc = cluster.get("description") or ""
   142→            steps = cluster.get("action_steps", [])
   143→            auto = cluster.get("auto", False)
   144→            tags: list[str] = []
   145→            if auto:
   146→                tags.append("auto")
   147→            if desc:
   148→                tags.append("desc")
   149→            else:
   150→                tags.append("no desc")
   151→            if steps:
   152→                tags.append(f"{len(steps)} steps")
   153→            else:
   154→                if not auto:
   155→                    tags.append("no steps")
   156→            tag_str = f" [{', '.join(tags)}]"
   157→            desc_str = f" \u2014 {desc}" if desc else ""
   158→            print(f"    {name}: {count} items{tag_str}{desc_str}")
   159→
   160→    all_clustered: set[str] = set()
   161→    for c in clusters.values():
   162→        all_clustered.update(c.get("finding_ids", []))
   163→    unclustered = [fid for fid in open_findings if fid not in all_clustered]
   164→    if unclustered:
   165→        print(colorize(f"\n  {len(unclustered)} findings not yet in a cluster:", "yellow"))
   166→        for fid in unclustered[:10]:
   167→            f = open_findings[fid]
   168→            dim = (f.get("detail", {}) or {}).get("dimension", "") if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else ""
   169→            short = _short_id(fid)
   170→            print(f"    [{short}] [{dim}] {f.get('summary', '')}")
   171→        if len(unclustered) > 10:
   172→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {len(unclustered) - 10} more", "dim"))
   173→    elif open_findings:
   174→        organized, total, _ = _synthesis_coverage(plan)
   175→        print(colorize(f"\n  All {organized}/{total} findings are in clusters.", "green"))
   176→
   177→
   178→def _apply_completion(args: argparse.Namespace, plan: dict, strategy: str) -> None:
   179→    """Shared completion logic: update meta, remove synthesis::pending, save."""
   180→    organized, total, clusters = _synthesis_coverage(plan)
   181→
   182→    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   183→    if SYNTHESIS_ID in order:
   184→        order.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
   185→
   186→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   187→    state = runtime.state
   188→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   189→
   190→    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   191→    meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   192→    if strategy.strip().lower() != "same":
   193→        meta["strategy_summary"] = strategy
   194→    meta["trigger"] = "manual_synthesis"
   195→    meta["last_completed_at"] = utc_now()
   196→    meta["synthesis_stages"] = {}  # clear stages on completion
   197→    meta.pop("stage_refresh_required", None)
   198→    meta.pop("stage_snapshot_hash", None)
   199→
   200→    save_plan(plan)

1→"""Stable review import mode normalization for command entrypoints."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from typing import Literal
     6→
     7→ReviewImportMode = Literal[
     8→    "auto",
     9→    "trusted_internal",
    10→    "attested_external",
    11→    "manual_override",
    12→]
    13→
    14→_ALLOWED_MODES: set[str] = {
    15→    "auto",
    16→    "trusted_internal",
    17→    "attested_external",
    18→    "manual_override",
    19→}
    20→
    21→
    22→def normalize_review_import_mode(raw: str | None) -> ReviewImportMode:
    23→    """Normalize user/caller import mode text to one stable mode token."""
    24→    mode = (raw or "auto").strip().lower().replace("-", "_")
    25→    if mode not in _ALLOWED_MODES:
    26→        allowed = ", ".join(sorted(_ALLOWED_MODES))
    27→        raise ValueError(f"invalid review import mode '{raw}'; expected one of: {allowed}")
    28→    return mode  # type: ignore[return-value]
    29→
    30→
    31→def _validate_mode_compatibility(
    32→    *,
    33→    mode: ReviewImportMode,
    34→    attested: bool,
    35→    manual: bool,
    36→) -> None:
    37→    if mode == "trusted_internal" and (attested or manual):
    38→        raise ValueError(
    39→            "import_mode=trusted_internal cannot be combined with attested/manual flags"
    40→        )
    41→    if mode == "attested_external" and manual:
    42→        raise ValueError(
    43→            "import_mode=attested_external cannot be combined with manual override flags"
    44→        )
    45→    if mode == "manual_override" and attested:
    46→        raise ValueError(
    47→            "import_mode=manual_override cannot be combined with attested external flags"
    48→        )
    49→
    50→
    51→def _apply_trusted_internal_defaults(
    52→    trusted_source: bool,
    53→    trusted_label: str | None,
    54→) -> tuple[bool, str, bool, bool]:
    55→    if not trusted_source:
    56→        trusted_source = True
    57→    if not isinstance(trusted_label, str) or not trusted_label.strip():
    58→        trusted_label = "trusted internal run-batches import"
    59→    return trusted_source, trusted_label, False, False
    60→
    61→
    62→def apply_review_import_mode(
    63→    *,
    64→    import_mode: str | None,
    65→    trusted_assessment_source: bool,
    66→    trusted_assessment_label: str | None,
    67→    attested_external: bool,
    68→    manual_override: bool,
    69→) -> tuple[bool, str | None, bool, bool]:
    70→    """Apply a canonical import mode over legacy booleans without dropping compatibility."""
    71→    mode = normalize_review_import_mode(import_mode)
    72→    trusted_source = bool(trusted_assessment_source)
    73→    trusted_label = trusted_assessment_label
    74→    attested = bool(attested_external)
    75→    manual = bool(manual_override)
    76→
    77→    _validate_mode_compatibility(mode=mode, attested=attested, manual=manual)
    78→
    79→    if mode == "trusted_internal":
    80→        return _apply_trusted_internal_defaults(trusted_source, trusted_label)
    81→    if mode == "attested_external":
    82→        return trusted_source, trusted_label, True, False
    83→    if mode == "manual_override":
    84→        return trusted_source, trusted_label, False, True
    85→
    86→    return trusted_source, trusted_label, attested, manual
    87→
    88→
    89→__all__ = [
    90→    "ReviewImportMode",
    91→    "apply_review_import_mode",
    92→    "normalize_review_import_mode",
    93→]
    94→

   439→def _cmd_stage_organize(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   440→    """Record the ORGANIZE stage: validates cluster enrichment.
   441→
   442→    Instead of gating on a text report, validates that the plan data
   443→    itself has been enriched: each manual cluster needs description +
   444→    action_steps. This forces the agent to actually think about each
   445→    cluster's execution plan.
   446→    """
   447→    plan = load_plan()
   448→
   449→    if SYNTHESIS_ID not in plan.get("queue_order", []):
   450→        print(colorize("  synthesis::pending is not in the queue \u2014 nothing to organize.", "yellow"))
   451→        return
   452→
   453→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   454→    stages = meta.get("synthesis_stages", {})
   455→    if "reflect" not in stages:
   456→        if "observe" not in stages:
   457→            print(colorize("  Cannot organize: observe stage not complete.", "red"))
   458→            print(colorize('  Run: desloppify plan synthesize --stage observe --report "..."', "dim"))
   459→        else:
   460→            print(colorize("  Cannot organize: reflect stage not complete.", "red"))
   461→            print(colorize('  Run: desloppify plan synthesize --stage reflect --report "..."', "dim"))
   462→        return
   463→    if not stages["reflect"].get("confirmed_at"):
   464→        print(colorize("  Cannot organize: reflect stage not confirmed.", "red"))
   465→        print(colorize("  Run: desloppify plan synthesize --confirm reflect", "dim"))
   466→        return
   467→
   468→    # Validate: at least 1 manual cluster with findings
   469→    manual_clusters = _manual_clusters_with_findings(plan)
   470→    if not manual_clusters:
   471→        # Check if there are ANY clusters with findings (including auto)
   472→        any_clusters = [
   473→            name for name, c in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   474→            if c.get("finding_ids")
   475→        ]
   476→        if any_clusters:

   482→        print(colorize("    desloppify plan cluster add <name> <finding-patterns>", "dim"))

   485→    # Validate: all manual clusters are enriched

   489→        for name, missing in gaps:

   498→        return
